"""Verify the inactive native RBX::Adorn interface, RBX::AdornG3D and RBX::AdornRbxGfx (2008-06).

Builds (document-swap flags plus the Ogre 1.4.5 client headers, VS2008 RTM 21022, /fp:fast), all from the current native
headers (native-headers/RbxGraphics/Adorn2008.h, AppDraw/AdornG3D2008.h, RbxGraphics/AdornRbxGfx2008.h and the
committed RbxGraphics/TextureProxyBase2008.h / RenderLib/TextureProxy2008.h; non-colliding names, so no donor header is
shadowed for any other unit):
  * tests/NativeAdornLayout.cpp        sizeof/offset probes (mov eax, imm32; ret) and nativeNewAdornG3D, which
                                       instantiates the header-inline constructor so that the object carries the
                                       AdornG3D vtable, ??_G and G3D::Table<TextureArgs, TextureRef>::freeMemory;
  * native-classes/AdornG3D.cpp        AdornG3D method bodies 00676480..00676aff;
  * tests/NativeAdornRbxGfxLayout.cpp  AdornRbxGfx sizeof/offset probes;
  * native-classes/AdornRbxGfx.cpp     AdornRbxGfx bodies that need only its own layout, and the container COMDATs of
                                       its image block (0066fc30..00671d5f).

A second, pending-only build of AdornRbxGfx.cpp (/DNATIVE_ADORNRBXGFX_PENDING plus generated header copies under
out/native-layouts/adornrbxgfx-pending/, ahead of native-headers for that build only) holds bodies that need proposed
declarations; its rows would be recorded exact=false (pending-build-only) and not counted; vtable checks use
current-header objects only. It is empty since 2026-11-06: RenderLib/TextureProxy2008.h declares the
RenderNew::TextureProxy(const std::string&) constructor 0066ffb0 (counted by record_native_render_material.py), so
createTextureProxy 00670380 is built and counted in the current build.

Every exact row is relocation-masked exact against the original, and every REL32/DIR32 target is bound to the address
the original instruction uses and verified: imports by DLL export name, constants by bytes, vtables by original RTTI
names, own symbols by the row proven here, folded bodies by their bytes, data by address, and the remaining externals
by the explicit EXTERNAL map (call sites read in the original disassembly, structure checked below). One address per
symbol. Rows folded by the linker onto bodies outside the class block are compared and recorded, not counted.
Writes work/2008-06/shared-layouts/adorn-working.json. Set NATIVE_ADORN_DISCOVER=1 to list unbound targets and
non-exact rows instead of asserting.

        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):

            if hit is not None:

                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
                assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]

                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)

                how = 'own row'

                how = 'data'

                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
            else:

            if record:

                assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def build_noinline(source, name):
    """Preprocess, mark CSimpleStringT::operator PCXSTR and IsEmpty noinline, compile (the browser-view profile)."""
    tool = rebuild.toolchain(21022)
    code, log = rebuild.run(tool, 'cl', [x for x in flags() if x != '/c'] + ['/P', str(source)], OUT)
    assert code == 0, log[-3000:]
    body = (OUT / (Path(source).stem + '.i')).read_text(errors='replace')
    for needle in ('operator PCXSTR() const throw()\n\t{\n\t\treturn( m_pszData );',
                   'bool IsEmpty() const throw()\n\t{\n\t\treturn( GetLength() == 0 );'):
        assert body.count(needle) == 1, needle
        body = body.replace(needle, '__declspec(noinline) ' + needle)
    unit = OUT / (name + '.cpp')
    unit.write_text(body)
    obj = OUT / (name + '.obj')
    code, log = rebuild.run(tool, 'cl', ['/nologo', '/c', '/O2', '/Ob2', '/Oy', '/GF', '/GS-', '/EHsc', '/MD',
                                         '/Fo' + str(obj), str(unit)], OUT)
    assert code == 0, log[-3000:]
    return obj

class ArchiveIndex(dict):
    """symbol -> member object path; a member is written under out/ only when one of its symbols is needed."""
    def __init__(self, path):
        dict.__init__(self)
        data, i, k = Path(path).read_bytes(), 8, 0
        assert data[:8] == b'!<arch>\n'
        self.members = {}
        while i < len(data):
            size = int(data[i + 48:i + 58])
            member = data[i + 60:i + 60 + size]
            if member[:2] == b'\x4c\x01':
                names = [n for n, _, _ in match.coff_functions(member)]
                if names:
                    obj = OUT / ('atls-member-%d.obj' % k)
                    self.members[obj] = member
                    k += 1
                    for n in names:
                        self.setdefault(n, obj)
            i += 60 + size + (size & 1)

    def get(self, symbol, default=None):
        obj = dict.get(self, symbol, default)
        if obj is not None and obj in self.members and not obj.exists():
            obj.write_bytes(self.members[obj])
        return obj

    def __getitem__(self, symbol):
        return self.get(symbol)


def archive_index(path):
    return ArchiveIndex(path)

def classify(symbol, value, raw, sections, definitions, where):
    hit = original.imported(value)
    if hit is not None:
        assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
        return '%s!%s' % hit
    if symbol.startswith('??_C@_1'):   # wide literal: up to the first aligned L'\0'
        pos, at = definitions[symbol]
        data = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]]
        end = next(i for i in range(0, len(data), 2) if data[i:i + 2] == b'\0\0') + 2
        literal = data[:end]
        assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'wide literal %r' % literal[:-2].decode('utf-16le')
    if symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
        pos, at = definitions[symbol]
        literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
        assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
    if symbol.startswith('__TI') and '?AV' in symbol:
        # _ThrowInfo: pCatchableTypeArray +12 -> first CatchableType -> TypeDescriptor name
        cta = d(value + 12)
        assert d(cta) == int(symbol[4]), (where, symbol, hex(value))
        name = original.string(d(d(cta + 4) + 4) + 8)
        assert name == '.' + symbol[5:], (where, symbol, hex(value), name)
        return 'throw info %s (%d catchable types)' % (name, d(cta))
    if symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
        rtti = original.string(value + 8)
        assert rtti == '.' + symbol[5:-2], (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'RTTI %s' % rtti
    if symbol.startswith('??_7'):
        rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
        assert rtti == '.?AV' + symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2], (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
    if symbol in own:
        assert own[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
        return 'pending-build-only row' if value in pending_addrs else 'own row'
    if symbol.startswith('??_E') and ('??_G' + symbol[4:]) in own:
        assert own['??_G' + symbol[4:]] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'own row (??_G)'
    if symbol in EXTERNAL:
        assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
        return 'external'
    if symbol in GUIDS:
        import uuid
        assert str(uuid.UUID(bytes_le=original.data(value, 16))) == GUIDS[symbol], (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'GUID {%s}' % GUIDS[symbol]
    if symbol in DATA:
        assert DATA[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(DATA[symbol]))
        return 'data'
    if EVIDENCE.get('%08x' % value, {}).get('symbol') == symbol:
        return 'evidence name'
    return instance(symbol, value, where)

def bodies_of(obj):
    if obj not in BODIES:
        BODIES[obj] = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(Path(obj).read_bytes())}
    return BODIES[obj]


def instance(symbol, value, where):
    """An inline / library body this build emits, proven by bytes at the called address and by its own targets."""
    if symbol in INSTANCES:
        assert INSTANCES[symbol]['address'] == '%08x' % value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'library instance (bytes equal)' if 'library' in INSTANCES[symbol].get('status', '') else \
            'instance (bytes equal, targets verified)'
    for obj in CURRENT[-1:] + LIBS + ([ATLS_INDEX[symbol]] if symbol in ATLS_INDEX else []):
        if symbol in bodies_of(obj):
            break
    else:
        return data_instance(symbol, value, where)
    library = obj in LIBS or obj == ATLS_INDEX.get(symbol)
    body = bodies_of(obj)[symbol][0]
    try:
        target, _, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % value)
        unlisted = False
    except SystemExit:   # not a listed function start (inside a merged extent): image bytes compared
        target, unlisted = b'', True
    merged = len(body) != len(target)
    # The function list cuts bodies at catch funclets / SEH filters and runs some library functions into their
    # neighbours; then the whole emitted body is compared with the image bytes at the called address.
    spec = (value, 0, len(body), 'raw') if merged else value
    INSTANCES[symbol] = {'address': '%08x' % value, 'pending': True}
    LENIENT.append(library)
    try:
        row = verify(obj, [(spec, symbol)], False)[0]
    except AssertionError:
        if not library:
            raise
        del INSTANCES[symbol]   # a donor-library body that differs proves nothing: leave the symbol unbound here
        return None
    finally:
        LENIENT.pop()
    row['status'] = 'instance (%s), bytes equal, not counted' % (
        ('library ' + ('atls.lib member' if obj == ATLS_INDEX.get(symbol) else Path(obj).stem) +
         '; its own targets bound where provable, library-internal ones listed as not followed')
        if library else 'emitted by this unit; every own target verified')
    if unlisted:
        row['status'] += '; not a listed function start, whole body compared with the image bytes'
    elif merged:
        row['status'] += '; listed extent %#x != body %#x, whole body compared with the image bytes' % (
            len(target), len(body))
    INSTANCES[symbol] = row
    return 'library instance (bytes equal)' if library else 'instance (bytes equal, targets verified)'


def data_instance(symbol, value, where):
    """Initialized data this unit defines (an ATL function-local static such as the window class info): bytes equal
    at the referenced address with relocated fields masked, and every relocated field bound like a code target."""
    if not CURRENT:
        return None
    obj = CURRENT[-1]
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, starts = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    if symbol not in definitions:
        return None
    pos, sec = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[sec]
    if table[9] & 0x20 or not table[9] & 0x40 or not table[4]:
        return None
    end = min([x for x in starts[sec + 1] if x > pos] + [table[3]])
    data = raw[table[4] + pos:table[4] + end]
    mine = original.data(value, len(data))
    fields = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if pos <= offset < end:
            assert kind == 6, (symbol, kind)
            fields[offset - pos] = symbols[index][0]
    mask = set(x + k for x in fields for k in range(4))
    assert all(a == b for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(data, mine)) if i not in mask), ('data bytes', symbol, hex(value))
    INSTANCES[symbol] = {'address': '%08x' % value, 'pending': True}
    verified = {}
    for off, target_symbol in sorted(fields.items()):
        target = (struct.unpack_from('<I', mine, off)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', data, off)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        how = classify(target_symbol, target, raw, sections, definitions, symbol)
        assert how is not None, ('unbound data field', symbol, off, target_symbol, hex(target))
        prev = binding.setdefault(target_symbol, target)

def verify_rows(obj, rows, exact_flag):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = bodies_of(obj)
    out = []
    for spec, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        address, lo, hi = spec[:3] if isinstance(spec, tuple) else (spec, 0, len(body))
        body, refs = body[lo:hi], [r - lo for r in refs if lo <= r < hi]
        if isinstance(spec, tuple) and spec[3:] == ('raw',):
            # Not a listed function: compare with the image bytes; every masked field is bound below.
            target, target_refs = original.data(address, len(body)), []
        else:
            target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        assert match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs), (name, hex(address), len(body), len(target))
        start, section = definitions[name]
        start += lo
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol) or symbol.startswith('__sehtable$'):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            how = classify(symbol, value, raw, sections, definitions, name)
            if how is None and LENIENT and LENIENT[-1]:
                verified[symbol] = '%s (library-internal, not followed)' % hex(value)
                continue
            assert how is not None, ('unbound relocation', name, symbol, hex(value))
            prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, value)
            assert prev == value, ('inconsistent binding', symbol, hex(prev), hex(value))
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        row = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name + ('' if (lo, hi) == (0, len(bodies[name][0])) else ' [%#x:%#x]' % (lo, hi)),
               'size': len(body), 'exact': exact_flag,
               'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)}
        if not exact_flag:
            row['status'] = 'pending-build-only'
        out.append(row)
    return out

def vtable_slots(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, starts = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    value, sec = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[sec]
    end = min([x for x in starts[sec + 1] if x > value] + [table[3]])
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if value <= offset < end:
            slots[(offset - value) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return raw, sections, definitions, slots


def local_body(raw, symbol, value):
    """An inline MFC body (CObject::Serialize & co.) emitted here: proven by bytes against the slot target."""
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    if symbol not in bodies:
        return None
    target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % value)
    body, refs = bodies[symbol]
    if not refs and len(body) == len(target) and match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs):
        return 'inline body, bytes equal (ICF-shared copy)'
    return None

def runtime_class(symbol, value):

    if not symbol.startswith('?GetThisClass@') or not symbol.endswith('@@SGPAUCRuntimeClass@@XZ'):

def classify(symbol, value, raw, sections, definitions, where):
    hit = original.imported(value)
    if hit is not None:
        assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
        return '%s!%s' % hit
    if symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
        pos, at = definitions[symbol]
        literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
        assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
    if symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
        rtti = original.string(value + 8)
        assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'RTTI %s' % rtti
    if symbol.startswith('__TI') and '?AV' in symbol:
        # _ThrowInfo: pCatchableTypeArray +12 -> first CatchableType -> TypeDescriptor name
        cta = d(value + 12)
        assert d(cta) == int(symbol[4]), (where, symbol, hex(value))
        name = original.string(d(d(cta + 4) + 4) + 8)
        assert name == '.' + symbol[5:], (where, symbol, hex(value), name)
        return 'throw info %s (%d catchable types)' % (name, d(cta))
    if symbol.startswith('??_7'):
        rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
        assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
    if symbol in own:
        assert own[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
        return 'own row'
    if symbol.startswith('??_E') and ('??_G' + symbol[4:]) in own:
        assert own['??_G' + symbol[4:]] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'own row (??_G)'
    if symbol in PENDING_OWN and CURRENT and CURRENT[-1] == OBJ['pending']:
        assert PENDING_OWN[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(PENDING_OWN[symbol]))
        return 'pending-build-only row'
    if symbol in EXTERNAL:

def type_singleton(symbol, value):
    """Reflection::Type::singleton<X>() defined in another unit: its guarded static Type is constructed with the
    type_info of X (push of the RTTI type descriptor whose name is X's)."""
    prefix, suffix = '??$singleton@', '@Type@Reflection@RBX@@SAABV012@XZ'
    if not (symbol.startswith(prefix) and symbol.endswith(suffix)):
        return None
    arg = symbol[len(prefix):-len(suffix)]
    want = '.' + (('?A' + arg) if arg[0] in 'VU' else arg)
    body = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % value)[0]
    for i in range(len(body) - 5):
        if body[i] == 0x68:
            td = struct.unpack_from('<I', body, i + 1)[0]
            try:
                name = original.string(td + 8)
            except Exception:
                continue
            if name == want:
                return 'Type::singleton (pushes type descriptor %#x %s)' % (td, name)
    return None

def verify_rows(obj, rows):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = bodies_of(obj)
    out = []
    for spec, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        address, lo, hi = spec[:3] if isinstance(spec, tuple) else (spec, 0, len(body))
        body, refs = body[lo:hi], [r - lo for r in refs if lo <= r < hi]
        if isinstance(spec, tuple) and spec[3:] == ('raw',):
            target, target_refs = original.data(address, len(body)), []
        else:
            target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        assert match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs), (name, hex(address), len(body), len(target))
        start, section = definitions[name]
        start += lo
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol) or symbol.startswith('__sehtable$'):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            how = classify(symbol, value, raw, sections, definitions, name)
            assert how is not None, ('unbound relocation', name, symbol, hex(value))
            prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, value)
            assert prev == value, ('inconsistent binding', symbol, hex(prev), hex(value))
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        row = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name + ('' if (lo, hi) == (0, len(bodies[name][0])) else ' [%#x:%#x]' % (lo, hi)),
               'size': len(body), 'exact': True, 'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)}
        out.append(row)
    return out


def vtable_slots(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, starts = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    value, sec = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[sec]
    end = min([x for x in starts[sec + 1] if x > value] + [table[3]])
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if value <= offset < end:
            slots[(offset - value) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return raw, sections, definitions, slots

    """An inline MFC body (CObject::Serialize & co.) emitted here: proven by bytes against the slot target."""
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    if symbol not in bodies:
        return None
    target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % value)
    body, refs = bodies[symbol]
    if not refs and len(body) == len(target) and match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs):
        return 'inline body, bytes equal (ICF-shared copy)'
    return None

    # body is compared with the image bytes at the address (relocated fields masked, every one bound below).
    spec = value if listed == len(body) else (value, 0, len(body), 'raw')

        else:

            else:

        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])

def ctor_vtables(address):
    """Vtables a constructor body stores (C7 /0 imm32 into a register base), with their original RTTI class."""
    body, _, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
    found = []
    for i in range(len(body) - 6):
        if body[i] == 0xc7 and (body[i + 1] & 0xf8) in (0x00, 0x40, 0x80):
            off = {0x00: 0, 0x40: 1, 0x80: 4}[body[i + 1] & 0xc0]
            v = struct.unpack_from('<I', body, i + 2 + off)[0]
            try:
                c = original.vtable_class(v)
            except Exception:
                continue
            if c and c[0]:
                found.append((v, c))
    return found

def prove_constructor(symbol, value):

        return 'evidence name'
    cls = symbol[3:-len('QAE@XZ')]
    stores = [v for v, c in ctor_vtables(value) if c == ('.?AV' + cls, 0)]
    assert stores, (symbol, hex(value), ctor_vtables(value))
    return 'stores the .?AV%s complete-object vtable %s' % (cls, hex(stores[0]))


def verify(build, obj, rows, record=True):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    own = {s: a for a, s in rows}
    out = []
    for address, name in rows:
        assert name in bodies, (build, hex(address), name)
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        row = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target),
               'exact': bool(exact), 'build': build, 'verified_targets': {}, 'local_eh': []}
        out.append(row)
        if not exact:
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            where = '%08x+%#x' % (address, offset)
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                row['local_eh'].append(symbol)
                continue
            how = None
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
                rtti = original.string(value + 8)
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'RTTI %s' % rtti
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol in COUNTED_TARGETS:
                other, receipts = COUNTED_TARGETS[symbol]
                assert other == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(other))
                hb, hr = bodies[symbol]
                ht, htr, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % value)
                assert match.exact_match(ht, htr, hb, hr), ('counted-elsewhere body not exact', symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'row counted by %s (compiled body exact at the bound address)' % ', '.join(receipts)
            elif symbol in NAME_DATA:
                assert original.string(value) == NAME_DATA[symbol], (where, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'class-name array %r (string at the pushed address)' % NAME_DATA[symbol]
            elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                if symbol in CTOR:
                    how = 'constructor: ' + CONSTRUCTOR_PROOF.setdefault(symbol, prove_constructor(symbol, value))
                else:
                    how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
            elif symbol in bodies:
                # helper / COMDAT body compiled here but not a row: exact at the bound address, never counted
                hb, hr = bodies[symbol]
                ht, htr, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % value)
                assert match.exact_match(ht, htr, hb, hr) or DISCOVER, (where, symbol, hex(value))
                HELPERS.setdefault(symbol, '%#x' % value)
                how = 'helper body exact at the bound address (not counted)'
            elif symbol in definitions and symbol not in bodies:
                assert any(lo <= value < hi for lo, hi in DATA_SECTIONS), (where, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'own static (bound by consistency)'
            elif names.get(value, '') == symbol:
                how = 'external (evidence name)'
            if how is None:
                UNBOUND.append((where, symbol, hex(value), names.get(value, '')[:80]))
                continue
            if record:
                bind(symbol, value, where)
            row['verified_targets'][symbol] = '%#x (%s)' % (value, how)
    return out

def malloc_size(address):
    body, _, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
    sizes = [struct.unpack_from('<I', body, k.start() + 1)[0] for k in re.finditer(rb'\x68', body)]

def holds_string(address, text):
    """The row's bytes hold a DIR32 pointer to that exact NUL-terminated string."""
    body = original.data(address, FUNCTIONS[address]['size'])
    for i in range(len(body) - 3):
        v = struct.unpack_from('<I', body, i)[0]
        if any(lo <= v < hi for lo, hi in DATA_SECTIONS):
            try:
                if original.string(v) == text:
                    return True
            except Exception:
                pass
    return False

RDATA_BYTES = RDATA.get_data()


def in_vtable(address, rtti_prefix):
    """Some original vtable slot holds the row and the vtable's complete-object locator names that class."""
    pat = struct.pack('<I', address)
    for m in re.finditer(re.escape(pat), RDATA_BYTES):
        if m.start() % 4:
            continue
        ref = RDATA_VA + m.start()
        for back in range(0, 120):
            try:
                rtti, _ = original.vtable_class(ref - 4 * back)
            except Exception:
                continue
            if rtti and rtti.startswith(rtti_prefix):
                return True
            if rtti:
                break
    return False

def bind_value(sections, symbols, definitions, name, body, target, address, own):
    start, section = definitions[name]
    table = sections[section]
    code = raw[table[4] + start:]
    verified, local = {}, set()
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        offset -= start
        if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
            continue
        symbol = symbols[index][0]
        if kind == 20:
            value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        else:
            value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            local.add(symbol)
            continue
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
            how = '%s!%s' % hit
        elif symbol in own:
            assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
            how = 'own row'
        elif symbol in SUPPORT:
            assert SUPPORT[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(SUPPORT[symbol]))
            sbody, srefs = BODIES[symbol]
            starget, strefs = target_of(value)
            assert match.exact_match(starget, strefs, sbody, srefs), ('support body not exact', symbol, hex(value))

            how = 'support body exact at the bound address'
        elif symbol in COUNTED_ELSEWHERE:
            at, receipt = COUNTED_ELSEWHERE[symbol]
            assert at == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(at))
            data = json.loads((ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts' / receipt).read_text())
            assert '%08x' % value in data['exact_function_rows'], (symbol, receipt)
            sbody, srefs = BODIES[symbol]
            starget, strefs = target_of(value)
            assert match.exact_match(starget, strefs, sbody, srefs), ('counted-elsewhere body not exact', symbol)
            elsewhere_out[symbol] = '%s counted by %s (this build exact there)' % (hex(value), receipt)
            how = 'row counted by %s (this build exact there)' % receipt
        elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
            how = 'external (call site in the original)'
        elif symbol in DATA:
            assert DATA[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(DATA[symbol]))
            how = 'data (address the original uses)'
        else:
            UNBOUND.append('    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s' % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
            continue
        prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
        assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
        verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
    return verified, local


def verify(rows, own):
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = BODIES[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target),
                 'exact': exact, 'unit': 'templates'}
        if not exact:
            assert DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        verified, local = bind_value(sections, symbols, definitions, name, body, target, address, own)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            rows = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk({k: v for k, v in data.items() if 'pending' not in k})
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = list(rows)
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault('%08x' % int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

def bind(symbol, value, where):
    prev = BINDING.setdefault(symbol, (value, where))
    assert prev[0] == value, ('one address per symbol', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), where)


def receipt_symbols(name, address):
    """Symbols another receipt records as counted exact at `address` (top-level exact_function_rows, else exact rows)."""
    data = json.loads((ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts' / name).read_text())
    if 'exact_function_rows' in data and '%08x' % address not in [str(r) for r in data['exact_function_rows']]:
        return []
    found = []

    def walk(o):
        if isinstance(o, dict):
            if o.get('address') == '%08x' % address and o.get('symbol') and o.get('exact') is True:
                found.append(o['symbol'])
            for v in o.values():
                walk(v)
        elif isinstance(o, list):
            for v in o:
                walk(v)
    walk(data)
    return found


def ctor_vtables(address):
    """Vtables a constructor body stores (C7 /0 imm32 into a register base), with their original RTTI class."""
    body, _, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
    found = []
    for i in range(len(body) - 6):
        if body[i] == 0xc7 and (body[i + 1] & 0xf8) in (0x00, 0x40, 0x80):
            off = {0x00: 0, 0x40: 1, 0x80: 4}[body[i + 1] & 0xc0]
            v = struct.unpack_from('<I', body, i + 2 + off)[0]
            try:
                c = original.vtable_class(v)
            except Exception:
                continue
            if c and c[0]:
                found.append((v, c))
    return found


def prove_constructor(symbol, value):
    cls = symbol[3:symbol.index('@@QAE@') + 2]
    if names.get(value, '') == symbol:
        return 'evidence name'
    stores = [v for v, c in ctor_vtables(value) if norm(c[0]) == norm('.?AV' + cls) and c[1] == 0]
    if not stores:
        return None
    return 'stores the .?AV%s complete-object vtable %s' % (cls, hex(stores[0]))


def counted_target(symbol):
    for (kind, c), (addr, receipt) in COUNTED_TARGETS.items():
        sc = CREATORS[c][0]
        if kind == 'shared_count' and symbol.startswith('??$?0PAV' + sc) and '@shared_count@detail@boost@@' in symbol:
            return addr, receipt
    return None


def verify(build, obj, rows):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = BODIES[build]
    out = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        row = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target),
               'exact': bool(exact), 'build': build, 'verified_targets': {}, 'local_eh': []}
        out.append(row)
        if not exact:
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            where = '%08x+%#x' % (address, offset)
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                row['local_eh'].append(symbol)
                continue
            how = None
            hit = original.imported(value)
            ct = counted_target(symbol)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol in ALL_OWN:
                assert ALL_OWN[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(ALL_OWN[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                lit = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(lit)) == lit, (where, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'literal %r' % lit[:-1].decode()
            elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
                rtti = original.string(value + 8)
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'RTTI %s' % rtti
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif ct is not None:
                other, receipt = ct
                assert other == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(other))
                assert symbol in receipt_symbols(receipt, value), (receipt, hex(value), symbol)
                if symbol in bodies:
                    hb, hr = bodies[symbol]
                    ht, htr, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % value)
                    assert match.exact_match(ht, htr, hb, hr), ('counted-elsewhere body not exact', symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'row counted by %s (body exact at the bound address)' % receipt
            elif symbol in NAME_DATA:
                assert original.string(value) == NAME_DATA[symbol], (where, symbol, hex(value), original.string(value))
                how = 'class-name array %r (string at the referenced address)' % NAME_DATA[symbol]
            elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
            elif symbol.startswith('??_E') and symbol.endswith('AEPAXI@Z') and \
                    '??_G' + symbol[4:] in bodies:
                # the adjustor thunks jump to the vector deleting destructor; the original slot holds the scalar
                # deleting destructor (no array delete of these classes), whose compiled body must be exact there
                g = '??_G' + symbol[4:]
                hb, hr = bodies[g]
                ht, htr, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % value)
                assert match.exact_match(ht, htr, hb, hr), (where, symbol, hex(value))
                how = '%s %s (scalar deleting destructor exact there; no array delete in the original)' % (
                    'own row' if value in ALL_OWN.values() else 'helper body', g[:48])
            elif symbol in bodies:
                # helper / COMDAT body compiled here but not a row: exact at the bound address, never counted
                hb, hr = bodies[symbol]
                ht, htr, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % value)
                ok = match.exact_match(ht, htr, hb, hr)
                assert ok or DISCOVER, (where, symbol, hex(value))
                HELPERS.setdefault(symbol, '%#x' % value)
                how = 'helper body exact at the bound address (not counted)'
            elif symbol.startswith('??0') and '@@QAE@' in symbol and prove_constructor(symbol, value):
                how = 'constructor: ' + CONSTRUCTOR_PROOF.setdefault(symbol, prove_constructor(symbol, value))
            elif symbol in definitions and symbol not in bodies:
                assert any(lo <= value < hi for lo, hi in DATA_SECTIONS), (where, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'own static (bound by consistency)'
            elif names.get(value, '') == symbol:
                how = 'external (evidence name)'
            if how is None:
                UNBOUND.append((where, symbol, hex(value), names.get(value, '')[:80]))
                continue
            bind(symbol, value, where)
            row['verified_targets'][symbol] = '%#x (%s)' % (value, how)
    return out

def compiled_vtables(obj):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, starts = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    out = {}
    for name, (start, sec) in definitions.items():
        if not name.startswith('??_7'):
            continue
        table = sections[sec]
        end = min([x for x in starts.get(sec + 1, ()) if x > start] + [table[3]])
        slots = {}
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            if start <= offset < end:
                slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
        out[name] = slots
    return out


def slot_hits(obj, rows):
    """Every counted row that a compiled vtable (current headers) holds must sit in the same slot of an original vtable
    whose RTTI names the same class."""
    compiled = compiled_vtables(obj)
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        symbol, address = row['symbol'], int(row['address'], 16)
        places = [(vt, i) for vt, slots in compiled.items() for i, s in slots.items() if s == symbol]
        if not places:
            continue
        hits = []
        for vt, i in places:
            cls = vt[4:vt.index('@@6B') + 2]
            for ref in rdata_refs(address):
                try:
                    rtti, at = original.vtable_class(ref - 4 * i)
                except Exception:
                    continue
                if norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls):
                    hits.append({'vtable': hex(ref - 4 * i), 'rtti': rtti, 'offset': hex(at), 'slot': i, 'compiled': vt})
        assert hits or DISCOVER, (row['address'], symbol, places)
        row['vtable_slots'] = hits
        out.append((row['address'], len(hits)))
    return out

def malloc_size(address):
    body, _, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
    sizes = [struct.unpack_from('<I', body, k.start() + 1)[0] for k in re.finditer(rb'\x68', body)]
    return [s for s in sizes if 0x40 <= s < 0x4000]

def holds_string(address, text):
    """The row's bytes hold a DIR32 pointer to that exact NUL-terminated string."""
    x = FUNCTIONS[address]
    body = original.data(address, x['size'])
    for i in range(len(body) - 3):
        v = struct.unpack_from('<I', body, i)[0]
        if any(lo <= v < hi for lo, hi in DATA_SECTIONS):
            try:
                if original.string(v) == text:
                    return True
            except Exception:
                pass
    return False


def holds_vtable(address, rtti):
    """The row's bytes hold a DIR32 pointer to an original vtable whose locator names that class, or the row is a
    slot of such a vtable."""
    x = FUNCTIONS[address]
    body = original.data(address, x['size'])
    for i in range(len(body) - 3):
        v = struct.unpack_from('<I', body, i)[0]
        if any(lo <= v < hi for lo, hi in DATA_SECTIONS):
            try:
                if original.vtable_class(v)[0] == rtti:
                    return True
            except Exception:
                pass
    for vt, _ in original_vtables(rtti):
        i = 0
        while TEXT[0] <= d(vt + 4 * i) < TEXT[1]:
            if d(vt + 4 * i) == address:
                return True
            i += 1
    return False

def counted_elsewhere():
    """Rows other receipts count: their top-level exact_function_rows (or an equivalent key); for receipts without
    one, every row object marked exact anywhere in the receipt (a conservative reading of their counted lists)."""
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        for key in ('exact_function_rows', 'exact_addresses', 'exact_unique_addresses', 'exact_distinct_addresses'):
            if isinstance(data.get(key), (list, dict)):
                rows = list(data[key])
                break
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    for v in o.values():
                        walk(v)
            walk(data)
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault('%08x' % int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

def classify(symbol, value, raw, sections, definitions, where):
    hit = original.imported(value)
    if hit is not None:
        assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
        return '%s!%s' % hit
    if symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
        pos, at = definitions[symbol]
        literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
        assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
    if symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
        rtti = original.string(value + 8)
        assert rtti == '.' + symbol[5:-2], (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'RTTI %s' % rtti
    if symbol.startswith('??_7'):
        rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
        assert rtti == '.?AV' + symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2], (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
    g = guid_of(symbol)
    if g is not None:
        assert original.data(value, 16) == uuid.UUID(g[0]).bytes_le, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'GUID {%s} (%s)' % g
    if symbol in NAME_DATA:
        text = NAME_DATA[symbol].encode() + b'\0'
        assert original.data(value, len(text)) == text, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'class-name array %r (string at the pushed address)' % NAME_DATA[symbol]
    if symbol in own:
        assert own[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
        return 'own row'
    if ('?1??' in symbol or symbol.startswith('??_B?1??')) and DATA_LO <= value < DATA_HI:
        LOCAL_STATICS.setdefault(symbol, set()).add(where)
        return 'own static (bound by consistency)'
    if symbol in EXTERNAL:
        assert EXTERNAL[symbol][0] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol][0]))
        return 'external (%s)' % EXTERNAL[symbol][1]
    if EVIDENCE.get('%08x' % value, {}).get('symbol') == symbol:
        return 'evidence name'
    return instance(symbol, value, where)


def bodies_of(obj):
    if obj not in BODIES:
        BODIES[obj] = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(Path(obj).read_bytes())}
    return BODIES[obj]


def instance(symbol, value, where):
    """An inline body this build emits, proven by bytes at the referenced address and by its own targets."""
    if symbol in INSTANCES:
        assert INSTANCES[symbol]['address'].replace('0x', '') == '%08x' % value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'instance (bytes equal, targets verified)'
    obj = CURRENT[-1]
    if symbol not in bodies_of(obj):
        return data_instance(symbol, value, where)
    for alt in [obj] + ALT.get(obj, []):
        if symbol in bodies_of(alt) and alt_exact(alt, symbol, value):
            obj = alt
            break
    body = bodies_of(obj)[symbol][0]
    try:
        target, _, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % value)
        unlisted = False
    except SystemExit:
        target, unlisted = b'', True
    merged = len(body) != len(target)
    spec = (value, 0, len(body), 'raw') if merged else value
    INSTANCES[symbol] = {'address': '%08x' % value, 'pending': True}
    row = verify(obj, [(spec, symbol)], False)[0]
    row['status'] = 'instance (emitted by this build; every own target verified), bytes equal, not counted'
    if unlisted:
        row['status'] += '; not a listed function start, whole body compared with the image bytes'
    elif merged:
        row['status'] += '; listed extent %#x != body %#x, whole body compared with the image bytes' % (
            len(target), len(body))
    INSTANCES[symbol] = row
    return 'instance (bytes equal, targets verified)'


def alt_exact(obj, symbol, value):
    body, refs = bodies_of(obj)[symbol]
    try:
        target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % value)
    except SystemExit:
        return False
    if len(target) != len(body):
        target, target_refs = original.data(value, len(body)), []
    return match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)


def data_instance(symbol, value, where):
    obj = CURRENT[-1]
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, starts = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    if symbol not in definitions:
        return None
    pos, sec = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[sec]
    if table[9] & 0x20 or not table[9] & 0x40 or not table[4]:
        return None
    end = min([x for x in starts[sec + 1] if x > pos] + [table[3]])
    data = raw[table[4] + pos:table[4] + end]
    mine = original.data(value, len(data))
    fields = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if pos <= offset < end:
            assert kind == 6, (symbol, kind)
            fields[offset - pos] = symbols[index][0]
    mask = set(x + k for x in fields for k in range(4))
    assert all(a == b for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(data, mine)) if i not in mask), ('data bytes', symbol, hex(value))
    INSTANCES[symbol] = {'address': '%08x' % value, 'pending': True}
    verified = {}
    for off, target_symbol in sorted(fields.items()):
        target = (struct.unpack_from('<I', mine, off)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', data, off)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        how = classify(target_symbol, target, raw, sections, definitions, symbol)
        assert how is not None, ('unbound data field', symbol, off, target_symbol, hex(target))
        prev = binding.setdefault(target_symbol, target)
        assert prev == target, ('inconsistent binding', target_symbol, hex(prev), hex(target))
        verified['+%#x %s' % (off, target_symbol)] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(target), how)
    INSTANCES[symbol] = {'address': '%08x' % value, 'symbol': symbol, 'size': len(data), 'exact': False,
                         'status': 'data instance emitted by this build (bytes equal, fields verified), not counted',
                         'verified_targets': verified}
    return 'data instance (bytes equal, fields verified)'

def verify_rows(obj, specs, exact_flag):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = bodies_of(obj)
    out = []
    for spec, name in specs:
        assert name in bodies, ('not emitted', name, Path(obj).name)
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        address, lo, hi = spec[:3] if isinstance(spec, tuple) else (spec, 0, len(body))
        body, refs = body[lo:hi], [r - lo for r in refs if lo <= r < hi]
        if isinstance(spec, tuple) and spec[3:] == ('raw',):
            target, target_refs = original.data(address, len(body)), []
        else:
            target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        assert len(target) == len(body) and match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs), (
            name, hex(address), len(body), len(target))
        start, section = definitions[name]
        start += lo
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol) or symbol.startswith('__sehtable$'):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            how = classify(symbol, value, raw, sections, definitions, name)
            if how is None and os.environ.get('U410_COLLECT'):
                COLLECT.add((symbol, hex(value)))
                how = 'UNBOUND'
            assert how is not None, ('unbound relocation', name, symbol, hex(value))
            prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, value)
            assert prev == value, ('inconsistent binding', symbol, hex(prev), hex(value))
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        piece = '' if (lo, hi) == (0, len(bodies[name][0])) else ' [%#x:%#x]' % (lo, hi)
        out.append({'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name + piece, 'size': len(body), 'exact': exact_flag,
                    'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
    return out


def vtable_slots(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, starts = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    value, sec = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[sec]
    end = min([x for x in starts[sec + 1] if x > value] + [table[3]])
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if value <= offset < end:
            slots[(offset - value) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return raw, sections, definitions, slots

def addr_of(x):
    if isinstance(x, dict):

    try:
        return int(s[:8], 16) if len(s) >= 6 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in s[:6]) else None
    except ValueError:
        return None


def walk_exact(o, out):
    if isinstance(o, list):
        for e in o:

    elif isinstance(o, dict):
        if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
            out.append(o['address'])
        for k, v in o.items():
            if isinstance(v, (dict, list)):

def rtti_of(v):
    if not 0x7c0000 <= v < 0x980000:

    try:

def string_at(v):
    if not 0x7c0000 <= v < 0x980000:
        return None
    try:
        raw = original.data(v, 128)
    except Exception:
        return None
    end = raw.find(b'\0')
    if end < 3 or any(c < 0x20 and c not in (9, 10, 13) or c > 0x7e for c in raw[:end]):
        return None
    return raw[:end].decode('latin-1')


def refs_of(a):

    return {struct.unpack_from('<I', code, i)[0] for i in rel if i + 4 <= len(code)} | {

    strs = sorted({s for s in (string_at(x) for x in refs) if s})

    if r.get('callers'):

def classify(symbol, value, raw, sections, definitions, where):
    hit = original.imported(value)
    if hit is not None:
        assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
        return '%s!%s' % hit
    if symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
        pos, at = definitions[symbol]
        literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
        assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
    if symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
        rtti = original.string(value + 8)
        assert rtti == '.' + symbol[5:-2], (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'RTTI %s' % rtti
    if symbol.startswith('??_7'):
        rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
        assert rtti == '.?AV' + symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2], (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
    if symbol in GUIDS:
        data, source = GUIDS[symbol]
        assert original.data(value, 16) == data, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'GUID bytes (%s)' % source
    if symbol in own:
        assert own[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
        return 'own row'
    if ('?1??' in symbol or symbol.startswith('??_B?1??')) and DATA_LO <= value < DATA_HI:
        # Function-local static (or its guard) of an inline function this build emits: bound by consistency (the
        # same address at every use, enforced by `binding`) and listed under 'local_statics'.
        LOCAL_STATICS.setdefault(symbol, set()).add(where)
        return 'own static (bound by consistency)'
    if symbol in EXTERNAL:
        assert EXTERNAL[symbol][0] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol][0]))
        return 'external (%s)' % EXTERNAL[symbol][1]
    if EVIDENCE.get('%08x' % value, {}).get('symbol') == symbol:
        return 'evidence name'
    return instance(symbol, value, where)

def instance(symbol, value, where):
    """An inline body this build emits, proven by bytes at the called address and by its own targets."""
    if symbol in INSTANCES:
        assert INSTANCES[symbol]['address'] == '%08x' % value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'instance (bytes equal, targets verified)'
    obj = CURRENT[-1]
    if symbol not in bodies_of(obj):
        return data_instance(symbol, value, where)
    body = bodies_of(obj)[symbol][0]
    try:
        target, _, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % value)
        unlisted = False
    except SystemExit:
        target, unlisted = b'', True
    merged = len(body) != len(target)
    spec = (value, 0, len(body), 'raw') if merged else value
    INSTANCES[symbol] = {'address': '%08x' % value, 'pending': True}
    row = verify(obj, [(spec, symbol)], False)[0]
    row['status'] = 'instance (emitted by this build; every own target verified), bytes equal, not counted'
    if unlisted:
        row['status'] += '; not a listed function start, whole body compared with the image bytes'
    elif merged:
        row['status'] += '; listed extent %#x != body %#x, whole body compared with the image bytes' % (
            len(target), len(body))
    INSTANCES[symbol] = row
    return 'instance (bytes equal, targets verified)'


def data_instance(symbol, value, where):
    """Initialized data this build defines (COM interface map, type-info holder, Name statics): bytes equal at the
    referenced address with relocated fields masked, and every relocated field bound like a code target."""
    obj = CURRENT[-1]
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, starts = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    if symbol not in definitions:
        return None
    pos, sec = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[sec]
    if table[9] & 0x20 or not table[9] & 0x40 or not table[4]:
        return None
    end = min([x for x in starts[sec + 1] if x > pos] + [table[3]])
    data = raw[table[4] + pos:table[4] + end]
    mine = original.data(value, len(data))
    fields = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if pos <= offset < end:
            assert kind == 6, (symbol, kind)
            fields[offset - pos] = symbols[index][0]
    mask = set(x + k for x in fields for k in range(4))
    assert all(a == b for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(data, mine)) if i not in mask), ('data bytes', symbol, hex(value))
    INSTANCES[symbol] = {'address': '%08x' % value, 'pending': True}
    verified = {}
    for off, target_symbol in sorted(fields.items()):
        target = (struct.unpack_from('<I', mine, off)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', data, off)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        how = classify(target_symbol, target, raw, sections, definitions, symbol)
        assert how is not None, ('unbound data field', symbol, off, target_symbol, hex(target))
        prev = binding.setdefault(target_symbol, target)
        assert prev == target, ('inconsistent binding', target_symbol, hex(prev), hex(target))
        verified['+%#x %s' % (off, target_symbol)] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(target), how)
    INSTANCES[symbol] = {'address': '%08x' % value, 'symbol': symbol, 'size': len(data), 'exact': False,
                         'status': 'data instance emitted by this build (bytes equal, fields verified), not counted',
                         'verified_targets': verified}
    return 'data instance (bytes equal, fields verified)'


def verify(obj, specs, exact_flag):
    CURRENT.append(obj)

    finally:

def verify_rows(obj, specs, exact_flag):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = bodies_of(obj)
    out = []
    for spec, name in specs:
        assert name in bodies, ('not emitted', name)
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        address, lo, hi = spec[:3] if isinstance(spec, tuple) else (spec, 0, len(body))
        body, refs = body[lo:hi], [r - lo for r in refs if lo <= r < hi]
        if isinstance(spec, tuple) and spec[3:] == ('raw',):
            target, target_refs = original.data(address, len(body)), []
        else:
            target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        assert match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs), (name, hex(address), len(body), len(target))
        start, section = definitions[name]
        start += lo
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol) or symbol.startswith('__sehtable$'):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            how = classify(symbol, value, raw, sections, definitions, name)
            assert how is not None, ('unbound relocation', name, symbol, hex(value))
            prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, value)
            assert prev == value, ('inconsistent binding', symbol, hex(prev), hex(value))
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        piece = '' if (lo, hi) == (0, len(bodies[name][0])) else ' [%#x:%#x]' % (lo, hi)
        out.append({'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name + piece, 'size': len(body), 'exact': exact_flag,
                    'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
    return out

def vtable_slots(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()

def rtti_of(v):
    if not 0x7c0000 <= v < 0x980000:
        return None
    try:
        name, _ = original.vtable_class(v)

    return name if name and name.startswith('.?A') else None


def string_at(v):
    if not 0x7c0000 <= v < 0x980000:
        return None
    try:
        raw = original.data(v, 128)
    except Exception:
        return None
    end = raw.find(b'\0')
    if end < 3 or any(c < 0x20 and c not in (9, 10, 13) or c > 0x7e for c in raw[:end]):
        return None
    return raw[:end].decode('latin-1')

        int(x, 16) for x in FUNCS[a].get('data_refs', [])}

def bind(symbol, value, where):
    prev = BINDING.setdefault(symbol, (value, where))
    assert prev[0] == value, ('one address per symbol', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), where)


def receipt_counts(name, address, symbol):
    data = json.loads((ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts' / name).read_text())
    rows = data.get('exact_function_rows', data.get('exact_distinct_addresses', []))
    assert '%08x' % address in [str(r) for r in rows], (name, hex(address))
    found = []

    def walk(o):
        if isinstance(o, dict):
            if o.get('address') == '%08x' % address and o.get('symbol'):
                found.append(o['symbol'])
            for v in o.values():
                walk(v)
        elif isinstance(o, list):
            for v in o:
                walk(v)
    walk(data)
    assert symbol in found, (name, hex(address), symbol, found)


def verify(build_name, obj, rows):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    out = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        row = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target),
               'exact': bool(exact), 'build': build_name, 'verified_targets': {}, 'local_eh': []}
        out.append(row)
        if not exact:
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            where = '%08x+%#x' % (address, offset)
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                row['local_eh'].append(symbol)
                continue
            how = None
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol in CLASS_NAMES:
                lit = CLASS_NAMES[symbol].encode() + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(lit)) == lit, (where, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'class name %r' % CLASS_NAMES[symbol]
            elif symbol in IDENTITY:
                assert IDENTITY[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'identity (open row, see not_exact)'
            elif symbol in COUNTED_TARGETS:
                assert COUNTED_TARGETS[symbol][0] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
                receipt_counts(COUNTED_TARGETS[symbol][1], value, symbol)
                how = 'counted by %s' % COUNTED_TARGETS[symbol][1]
            elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
            elif symbol in bodies:
                hb, hr = bodies[symbol]
                ht, htr, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % value)
                assert match.exact_match(ht, htr, hb, hr), (where, symbol, hex(value))
                HELPERS.setdefault(symbol, '%#x' % value)
                how = 'helper body exact at the bound address (not counted)'
            elif symbol in definitions and symbol not in bodies:
                assert any(lo <= value < hi for lo, hi in DATA_SECTIONS), (where, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'own static (bound by consistency)'
            if how is None:
                UNBOUND.append((where, symbol, hex(value)))
                continue
            bind(symbol, value, where)
            row['verified_targets'][symbol] = '%#x (%s)' % (value, how)
    return out, bodies

def holds_string(address, text):
    """The row's bytes hold a DIR32 pointer to that exact NUL-terminated string."""
    body = original.data(address, FUNCTIONS[address]['size'])
    for i in range(len(body) - 3):
        v = struct.unpack_from('<I', body, i)[0]
        if any(lo <= v < hi for lo, hi in DATA_SECTIONS):
            try:
                if original.string(v) == text:
                    return True
            except Exception:
                pass
    return False

def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        for key in ('exact_function_rows', 'exact_addresses', 'exact_unique_addresses', 'exact_distinct_addresses'):
            if isinstance(data.get(key), (list, dict)):
                rows = list(data[key])
                break
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk(data.get('methods', []))
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault('%08x' % int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

def classify(symbol, value, raw, sections, definitions, where):
    hit = original.imported(value)

        return 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()

        rtti = original.string(value + 8)

def data_instance(symbol, value, where):
    """Initialized data this unit defines (a boost::function stored vtable): bytes equal at the referenced address with
    relocated fields masked, and every relocated field bound like a code target."""
    obj = CURRENT[-1]
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, starts = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    if symbol not in definitions:
        return None
    pos, sec = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[sec]
    if table[9] & 0x20 or not table[9] & 0x40 or not table[4]:
        return None
    end = min([x for x in starts[sec + 1] if x > pos] + [table[3]])
    data = raw[table[4] + pos:table[4] + end]
    mine = original.data(value, len(data))
    fields = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if pos <= offset < end:
            assert kind == 6, (symbol, kind)
            fields[offset - pos] = symbols[index][0]
    mask = set(x + k for x in fields for k in range(4))
    assert all(a == b for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(data, mine)) if i not in mask), ('data bytes', symbol, hex(value))
    INSTANCES[symbol] = {'address': '%08x' % value, 'pending': True}
    verified = {}

        assert prev == target, ('inconsistent binding', target_symbol, hex(prev), hex(target))
        verified['+%#x %s' % (off, target_symbol)] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(target), how)

        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol) or symbol.startswith('__sehtable$'):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            how = classify(symbol, value, raw, sections, definitions, name)
            assert how is not None, ('unbound relocation', name, symbol, hex(value))
            prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, value)
            assert prev == value, ('inconsistent binding', symbol, hex(prev), hex(value))
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        piece = '' if (lo, hi) == (0, len(bodies[name][0])) else ' [%#x:%#x]' % (lo, hi)
        out.append({'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name + piece, 'size': len(body), 'exact': exact_flag,

def vtable_slots(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, starts = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    value, sec = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[sec]
    end = min([x for x in starts[sec + 1] if x > value] + [table[3]])

        if value <= offset < end:
            slots[(offset - value) // 4] = symbols[index][0]

def classify(symbol, value, raw, sections, definitions, where):
    hit = original.imported(value)
    if hit is not None:
        assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
        return '%s!%s' % hit
    if symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
        pos, at = definitions[symbol]
        literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
        assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
    if symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
        rtti = original.string(value + 8)
        assert rtti == '.' + symbol[5:-2], (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'RTTI %s' % rtti
    if symbol.startswith('??_7'):
        rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
        assert rtti == '.?AV' + symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2], (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
    if symbol in own:
        assert own[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
        return 'own row'
    if symbol in EXTERNAL:
        assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
        return 'external'
    if EVIDENCE.get('%08x' % value, {}).get('symbol') == symbol:
        return 'evidence name'
    return instance(symbol, value, where)

def bodies_of(obj):
