def bind_value(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, bodies, name, body, target, address, own):
    start, section = definitions[name]
    table = sections[section]
    code = raw[table[4] + start:]
    verified, local = {}, set()
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        offset -= start
        if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
            continue
        symbol = symbols[index][0]
        if kind == 20:
            value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        else:
            value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            local.add(symbol)
            continue
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
            how = '%s!%s' % hit
        elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
            assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
        elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
            pos, at = definitions[symbol]
            literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
            assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'string %r' % literal[:-1].decode('latin-1')[:48]
        elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
            rtti = original.string(value + 8)
            assert rtti == '.' + symbol[5:-2], (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            how = 'RTTI type %s' % rtti
        elif symbol.startswith('__TI'):
            got = throw_info_names(value)
            cls = symbol[symbol.index('?'):]
            assert got and got[0] == '.' + cls, (name, symbol, hex(value), got)
            how = 'throw info, catchable types %s' % ' '.join(got)
        elif symbol.startswith('??_7') and symbol.endswith('@@6B@'):
            rtti, offset_in_object = original.vtable_class(value)
            assert rtti == '.?AV' + symbol[4:-3] and offset_in_object == 0, (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            how = 'vtable (RTTI %s)' % rtti
        elif symbol in own:
            assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
            how = 'own row'
        elif symbol in LIBRARY:
            at, lib = LIBRARY[symbol]
            assert at == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(at))
            lbody, lrefs = LIB_BODIES[lib][symbol]
            starget, strefs = target_of(value)
            assert match.exact_match(starget, strefs, lbody, lrefs), ('library body not exact', symbol, hex(value))
            lib_out[symbol] = '%s (library %s, body exact here; not counted)' % (hex(value), LIBRARY_SOURCES[lib].name)
            how = 'library body exact at the bound address (%s)' % LIBRARY_SOURCES[lib].name
        elif symbol in SUPPORT:
            assert SUPPORT[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(SUPPORT[symbol]))
            sbody, srefs = bodies[symbol]
            starget, strefs = target_of(value)
            assert match.exact_match(starget, strefs, sbody, srefs), ('support body not exact', symbol, hex(value))
            support_out.setdefault(symbol, {'address': hex(value), 'reached_from': name,
                                            'note': 'COMDAT support body, exact at the bound address; not counted'})
            how = 'support body exact at the bound address'
        elif symbol in SPLIT:
            at, tail_at = SPLIT[symbol]
            assert at == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(at))
            sbody, srefs = bodies[symbol]
            head, head_refs = target_of(at)
            tail, tail_refs = target_of(tail_at)
            assert len(head) + len(tail) == len(sbody), (symbol, len(head), len(tail), len(sbody))
            hrefs = [x for x in srefs if x < len(head)]
            trefs = [x - len(head) for x in srefs if x >= len(head)]
            assert match.exact_match(head, head_refs, sbody[:len(head)], hrefs), ('split head not exact', symbol)
            assert match.exact_match(tail, tail_refs, sbody[len(head):], trefs), ('split tail not exact', symbol)
            support_out.setdefault(symbol, {'address': hex(value), 'reached_from': name,
                                            'note': 'body exact split at the original extent, catch block at %s; '
                                                    'not counted' % hex(tail_at)})
            how = 'support body exact split at the original extent (catch block %s)' % hex(tail_at)
        elif symbol in COUNTED_ELSEWHERE:
            at, receipt = COUNTED_ELSEWHERE[symbol]
            assert at == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(at))
            data = json.loads((ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts' / receipt).read_text())
            assert '%08x' % value in data['exact_function_rows'], (symbol, receipt)
            how = 'row counted by %s' % receipt
        elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
            how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else ' (call site)')
        elif symbol in CRT:
            assert CRT[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'CRT helper (call site)'
        else:
            UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
            continue
        prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
        assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
        verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
    return verified, local


def verify(which, rows, own, count=True):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        verified, local = bind_value(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, bodies, name, body, target, address, own)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            rows = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            # older receipts: any entry marked exact outside pending sections (methods, rows, *_methods, trials)
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk({k: v for k, v in data.items() if 'pending' not in k})
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = list(rows)
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault('%08x' % int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

def load_bodies(obj):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {}
    for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw):
        start, section = definitions[n]
        table = sections[section]
        rel = []
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if 0 <= offset < len(b):
                rel.append((offset, symbols[index][0], kind))
        bodies.setdefault(n, (b, r, rel))
    return bodies


TARGET = {}


def target_of(address):
    if address not in TARGET:
        body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        TARGET[address] = (body, refs)
    return TARGET[address]


def throw_info_names(value):
    array = d32(value + 12)
    return [original.string(d32(d32(array + 4 + 4 * i) + 4) + 8) for i in range(d32(array))]


class Closure:
    def __init__(self, unit, roots, external):
        self.unit, self.external = unit, external
        self.obj = OBJ[unit]
        self.bodies = load_bodies(self.obj)
        self.raw = Path(self.obj).read_bytes()
        self.index = match._coff_data_index(self.raw)
        self.used, self.unbound = set(), []
        self.proven, self.aliases, self.why, self.not_exact = {}, {}, {}, {}
        queue = deque()
        self.roots = {}
        for address, pattern, evidence in roots:
            hits = [n for n in self.bodies if not nb.LOCAL_EH.match(n) and all(p in n for p in pattern)]
            if DISCOVER and len(hits) != 1:
                print('ROOT', unit, '%08x' % address, pattern, [h[:150] for h in hits])
                continue
            assert len(hits) == 1, ('root pattern must select one symbol', unit, pattern, hits)
            self.roots[address] = hits[0]
            queue.append((address, hits[0], 'root: ' + evidence))
        while queue:
            address, symbol, reason = queue.popleft()
            if address in self.proven:
                if symbol not in self.aliases[address]:
                    if self.exact_at(symbol, address):
                        self.aliases[address].append(symbol)
                    else:
                        self.not_exact.setdefault(address, (symbol, 'folded alias: ' + reason))
                continue
            if not self.exact_at(symbol, address):
                self.not_exact.setdefault(address, (symbol, reason))
                continue
            self.proven[address], self.aliases[address], self.why[address] = symbol, [symbol], reason
            _, _, rel = self.bodies[symbol]
            target, _ = target_of(address)
            for offset, sym, kind in rel:
                if kind == 20:
                    value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
                    if value in FUNCTIONS and sym in self.bodies and not nb.LOCAL_EH.match(sym) \
                            and sym not in self.external:
                        queue.append((value, sym, 'called by %08x' % address))
        self.own = {}
        for address, syms in self.aliases.items():
            for s in syms:
                prev = self.own.setdefault(s, address)
                assert prev == address, ('one address per symbol', s, hex(prev), hex(address))
        self.checked = {a: self.verify(a, s) for a, s in sorted(self.proven.items())}

    def exact_at(self, symbol, address):
        if symbol not in self.bodies or address not in FUNCTIONS:
            return False
        body, refs, _ = self.bodies[symbol]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        return len(body) == len(target) and match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)

    def resolve(self, owner, sym, value):
        sections, symbols, definitions, _ = self.index
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(sym), (owner, sym, hex(value), hit)
            return '%s!%s' % hit
        if sym.startswith('__real@'):
            assert original.data(value, len(sym[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(sym[7:])[::-1], (owner, sym)
            return 'constant %s' % sym[7:]
        if sym.startswith('??_C@'):
            pos, at = definitions[sym]
            literal = self.raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
            assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (owner, sym, hex(value))
            return 'string %r' % literal[:-1].decode('latin-1')
        if sym.startswith('??_7'):
            rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
            cls = sym[4:sym.index('@@6B') + 2]
            assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (owner, sym, hex(value), rtti)
            return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
        if sym.startswith('??_R0'):
            name = '.' + sym[5:-2]
            assert original.string(value + 8) == name, (owner, sym, hex(value), original.string(value + 8))
            return 'type descriptor %s' % name
        if sym.startswith('__TI'):
            got = throw_info_names(value)
            cls = sym[sym.index('?'):]
            assert got and got[0] == '.' + cls, (owner, sym, hex(value), got)
            return 'throw info, catchable types %s' % ' '.join(got)
        if sym in self.own:
            assert self.own[sym] == value, (owner, sym, hex(value), hex(self.own[sym]))
            return 'own row'
        if sym in self.external:
            assert self.external[sym] == value, (owner, sym, hex(value), hex(self.external[sym]))
            self.used.add(sym)
            return 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == sym else '')
        return None

    def verify(self, address, symbol):
        body, refs, rel = self.bodies[symbol]
        target, _ = target_of(address)
        sections, symbols, definitions, _ = self.index
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for offset, sym, kind in rel:
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                start, section = definitions[symbol]
                code = self.raw[sections[section][4] + start:]
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) \
                    & 0xffffffff
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(sym):
                local.add(sym)
                continue
            how = self.resolve(symbol, sym, value)
            if how is None:
                self.unbound.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s at %08x" % (sym, value, names.get(value, '')[:50],
                                                                          symbol[:50], address + offset))
                continue
            verified[sym] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        return {'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)}

    def check(self):
        if DISCOVER:
            print('==', self.unit)
            print('\n'.join(sorted(set(self.unbound))))
            for a, (s, r) in sorted(self.not_exact.items()):
                print('NOT EXACT %08x %s (%s)' % (a, s[:120], r))
            for a in sorted(self.proven):
                print('PROVEN %08x %s %s' % (a, self.proven[a][:110], self.why[a][:40]))
            print('UNUSED EXTERNAL', sorted(set(self.external) - self.used))
            return
        assert not self.unbound, '\n'.join(self.unbound)
        assert sorted(self.used) == sorted(self.external), sorted(set(self.external) - self.used)
        assert not self.not_exact, {('%08x' % a): v for a, v in self.not_exact.items()}
        for root_address in self.roots:
            assert root_address in self.proven, ('root not proven', '%08x' % root_address)

def throw_info_type(address):
    array = dword(address + 12)
    return original.data(dword(dword(array + 4) + 4) + 8, 64).split(b'\0')[0].decode('latin-1')


def target_of(address):
    body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
    return body, refs


def site_target(unit, name):
    """(target bytes, target relocs, address of byte i) for a compiled body, joined across a funclet split."""
    if name in SPLIT:
        at, tail_at = SPLIT[name]
        head, head_refs = target_of(at)
        tail, tail_refs = target_of(tail_at)
        return (head + tail, list(head_refs) + [x + len(head) for x in tail_refs],
                lambda i: (at + i) if i < len(head) else (tail_at + i - len(head)), len(head))
    at = OWN.get(name, SUPPORT.get(name))
    body, refs = target_of(at)
    return body, refs, (lambda i: at + i), None


def check_body(symbol, value):
    sbody, srefs = BODIES[symbol]
    starget, strefs = target_of(value)
    return len(sbody) == len(starget) and match.exact_match(starget, strefs, sbody, srefs)


def bind_value(name, target, addr_of):
    unit = UNIT_OF[name]
    raw = RAW[unit]
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    body, _ = BODIES[name]
    start, section = definitions[name]
    table = sections[section]
    code = raw[table[4] + start:]
    verified, local = {}, set()
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        offset -= start
        if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
            continue
        symbol = symbols[index][0]
        if kind == 20:
            value = (addr_of(offset) + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        else:
            value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            local.add(symbol)
            continue
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
            how = '%s!%s' % hit
        elif symbol in OWN:
            assert OWN[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(OWN[symbol]))
            how = 'own row'
        elif symbol in SUPPORT:
            assert SUPPORT[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(SUPPORT[symbol]))
            assert check_body(symbol, value), ('support body not exact', symbol, hex(value))
            support_out.setdefault(symbol, {'address': hex(value), 'reached_from': name,
                                            'note': 'COMDAT support body exact at the bound address; not counted'})
            how = 'support body exact at the bound address'
        elif symbol in COUNTED_ELSEWHERE:
            at, receipt = COUNTED_ELSEWHERE[symbol]
            assert at == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(at))
            data = json.loads((ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts' / receipt).read_text())
            assert '%08x' % value in data['exact_function_rows'], (symbol, receipt)
            assert check_body(symbol, value), ('ICF-shared body not exact', symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'ICF-shared row counted by %s (this build exact there)' % receipt
        elif symbol in VTABLES:
            at, rtti = VTABLES[symbol]
            assert at == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(at))
            assert original.vtable_class(value)[0] == rtti, (symbol, original.vtable_class(value))
            how = 'vtable (original RTTI %s)' % rtti
        elif symbol in DATA:
            at, want = DATA[symbol]
            assert at == value and original.data(value, len(want)) == want, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'data, bytes %s' % want.hex()
        elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
            how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else ' (call site; body evidence)')
        elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
            rtti = original.vtable_class(value)[0]
            assert rtti == '.?AV' + symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2], (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            how = 'vtable (original RTTI %s)' % rtti
        elif symbol.startswith('__TI'):
            assert throw_info_type(value) == '.' + symbol[symbol.index('?'):], (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'throw info (original type %s)' % throw_info_type(value)
        elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
            lpos, lsec = definitions[symbol]
            literal = raw[sections[lsec][4] + lpos:sections[lsec][4] + sections[lsec][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
            assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
        elif symbol in BODIES and check_body(symbol, value):
            # a COMDAT body this build emits, exact at the referenced address (ICF-shared or outside this range)
            other = ELSEWHERE_ALL.get('%08x' % value)
            if other:
                how = 'ICF-shared body exact at the bound address (row counted by %s)' % ', '.join(sorted(set(other)))
            else:
                how = 'support body exact at the bound address'
                support_out.setdefault(symbol, {'address': hex(value), 'reached_from': name,
                                                'note': 'COMDAT / ICF-shared body exact at the bound address; not '
                                                        'counted here'})
        else:
            UNBOUND.append('    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s' % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
            continue
        prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
        assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
        verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
    return verified, local


def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            rows = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk({k: v for k, v in data.items() if 'pending' not in k})
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = list(rows)
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault('%08x' % int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out


def verify(rows):
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = BODIES[name]
        target, target_refs, addr_of, split_at = site_target(UNIT_OF[name], name)
        exact = len(body) == len(target) and match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target),
                 'exact': exact, 'unit': UNIT_OF[name]}
        if split_at is not None:
            h = [x for x in refs if x < split_at]
            t = [x - split_at for x in refs if x >= split_at]
            head, head_refs = target_of(SPLIT[name][0])
            tail, tail_refs = target_of(SPLIT[name][1])
            exact = exact and match.exact_match(head, head_refs, body[:split_at], h) \
                and match.exact_match(tail, tail_refs, body[split_at:], t)
            entry.update({'exact': exact, 'target_size': len(head),
                          'split': 'compiled %d B = row %d B + catch-funclet row %s %d B (both halves exact)'
                                   % (len(body), len(head), '%08x' % SPLIT[name][1], len(tail))})
        if not exact:
            assert DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        verified, local = bind_value(name, target, addr_of)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def vtable_slots(unit, vsym):
    raw = RAW[unit]
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[vsym]
    table = sections[section]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):

        if offset >= start:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return slots

def bind_value(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, bodies, name, body, target, address, own):
    start, section = definitions[name]
    table = sections[section]
    code = raw[table[4] + start:]
    verified, local = {}, set()
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        offset -= start
        if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
            continue
        symbol = symbols[index][0]
        if kind == 20:
            value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        else:
            value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            local.add(symbol)
            continue
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
            how = '%s!%s' % hit
        elif symbol in own:
            assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
            how = 'own row'
        elif symbol in VTABLES:
            vt, rtti = VTABLES[symbol]
            assert vt == value and original.vtable_class(vt) == (rtti, 0), (name, symbol, hex(value), original.vtable_class(value))
            how = 'vtable by RTTI %s' % rtti

            want = ('.' + symbol[5:-2]).encode()
            assert original.data(value + 8, len(want) + 1) == want + b'\0', (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'type descriptor %s (by bytes)' % want.decode()

            how = 'body exact at the bound address; row counted by %s' % other[1]

        prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))

def verify(which, rows, own):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        verified, local = bind_value(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, bodies, name, body, target, address, own)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def vtable_slots(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    if symbol not in definitions:
        return None
    start, index = definitions[symbol]
    section = sections[index]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(section[7]):
        offset, sym, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, section[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start and kind == 6:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[sym][0]
    return slots

    count = 0
    while TEXT[0] <= d(vt + 4 * count) < TEXT[1]:
        count += 1
    assert len(slots) == count, (symbol, slots, count)
    entries = {}
    for slot, name in sorted(slots.items()):
        value = d(vt + 4 * slot)
        body_name = '??_G' + name[4:] if name.startswith('??_E') else name
        if signal_own.get(body_name) is not None:
            assert signal_own[body_name] == value, (symbol, slot, name, hex(value))
            entries[slot] = '%s -> %s (own row)' % (name[:80], hex(value))
            continue
        assert value not in counted_addresses, (symbol, slot, name, hex(value))
        sbody, srefs = signal_bodies[body_name]
        starget, strefs = target_of(value)
        assert match.exact_match(starget, strefs, sbody, srefs), ('slot body not exact', symbol, slot, name, hex(value))
        entries[slot] = '%s -> %s (ICF-shared body exact at the original slot; not counted here)' % (name[:80], hex(value))
    vtables.append({'vtable': hex(vt), 'symbol': symbol, 'rtti': rtti, 'original_slots': count, 'slots': entries})

                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])

def bind_value(name, size, target, address):
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = INDEX
    start, section = definitions[name]
    table = sections[section]
    code = raw[table[4] + start:]
    verified, local = {}, set()
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        offset -= start
        if not 0 <= offset < size:
            continue
        symbol = symbols[index][0]
        assert kind in (6, 20), (name, symbol, 'unsupported relocation', kind)
        if kind == 20:
            value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        else:
            value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol) and symbol not in OWN:
            local.add(symbol)
            continue
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
            how = '%s!%s' % hit
        elif symbol in OWN:
            assert OWN[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(OWN[symbol]))
            how = 'own row'
        elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
            rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
            assert rtti == '.?AV' + symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2], (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
        elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
            rtti = original.string(value + 8)
            assert rtti == '.' + symbol[5:-2], (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            how = 'RTTI %s' % rtti
        elif symbol in SUPPORT:
            assert SUPPORT[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(SUPPORT[symbol]))
            sbody, srefs = BODIES[symbol]
            starget, strefs = target_of(value)
            assert match.exact_match(starget, strefs, sbody, srefs), ('support body not exact', symbol, hex(value))
            support_out.setdefault(symbol, {'address': '%08x support body, not counted' % value, 'reached_from': name,
                                            'note': 'COMDAT support body, exact at the bound address; not counted'})
            how = 'support body exact at the bound address'
        elif symbol in COUNTED_ELSEWHERE:
            at, receipt = COUNTED_ELSEWHERE[symbol]
            assert at == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(at))
            assert receipt_counts(receipt, value), (symbol, receipt)
            if symbol in BODIES:
                sbody, srefs = BODIES[symbol]
                starget, strefs = target_of(value)
                assert match.exact_match(starget, strefs, sbody, srefs), ('counted-elsewhere body not exact', symbol,
                                                                          hex(value))
                how = 'counted by %s (this build exact there)' % receipt
            else:
                assert names.get(value) == symbol, (symbol, hex(value), names.get(value))
                how = 'counted by %s (external here; evidence name)' % receipt
            elsewhere_out[symbol] = '%08x %s' % (value, how)
        elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
            at, why = EXTERNAL[symbol]
            assert at == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(at))
            if symbol in EVIDENCE_NAMED:
                assert names.get(at) == symbol, (symbol, hex(at), names.get(at))
            how = 'external: ' + why
        else:
            UNBOUND.append('    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s' % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
            continue
        prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
        assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
        verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
    return verified, local


def verify_row(address, name, body, refs, note=None, split_head=False):
    target, target_refs = target_of(address)
    if split_head and len(body) > len(target):   # split head only: compare over the row's extent
        refs = [r for r in refs if r + 4 <= len(target)]
        body = body[:len(target)]
    exact = len(body) == len(target) and match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
    entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target),
             'exact': exact, 'unit': 'templates'}
    if note:
        entry['note'] = note
    if not exact:
        assert DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
        return entry
    assert set(target_refs) <= set(refs), (name, 'missing original relocation')
    verified, local = bind_value(name, len(body), target, address)
    entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
    return entry

def compiled_vtable(symbol):
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = INDEX
    start, section = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[section]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, sym, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[sym][0]
    return [slots[i] for i in range(len(slots))]

def target_of(address):
    body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)

def resolve(obj, rows):
    funcs = match.coff_functions(Path(obj).read_bytes())
    out = []
    for address, key in rows:
        key, contains = key if isinstance(key, tuple) else (key, '')
        hits = [x for x in funcs if x[0] == key] or [x for x in funcs if x[0].startswith(key) and contains in x[0]
                                                      and not nb.LOCAL_EH.match(x[0])]
        if DISCOVER and len(hits) != 1:
            print('UNRESOLVED', '%08x' % address, key[:120], [h[0][:120] for h in hits])
            continue
        assert len(hits) == 1, ('%08x' % address, key, [h[0] for h in hits])
        out.append((address, hits[0][0]))
    return out


def support_address(symbol):

        if symbol.startswith(prefix):
            return value
    return None


def counted_address(symbol):

def bind_value(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, bodies, name, body, target, address, own, record=True, depth=0):
    start, section = definitions[name]
    table = sections[section]
    code = raw[table[4] + start:]
    verified, local = {}, set()
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        offset -= start
        if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
            continue
        symbol = symbols[index][0]
        if kind == 20:
            value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        else:
            value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            local.add(symbol)
            continue
        hit = original.imported(value)
        sup = support_address(symbol)
        other = counted_address(symbol)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
            how = '%s!%s' % hit
        elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
            assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
        elif symbol in own:
            assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
            how = 'own row'
        elif symbol in VTABLES:
            vt, rtti = VTABLES[symbol]
            assert vt == value and original.vtable_class(vt) == (rtti, 0), (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'vtable by RTTI %s' % rtti
        elif other is not None:
            assert other[0] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(other[0]))
            sbody, srefs = bodies[symbol]
            starget, strefs = target_of(value)
            assert match.exact_match(starget, strefs, sbody, srefs), ('counted-elsewhere body not exact', symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'body exact at the bound address; row counted by %s' % other[1]
        elif sup is not None:
            assert sup == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(sup))
            sbody, srefs = bodies[symbol]
            starget, strefs = target_of(value)
            assert match.exact_match(starget, strefs, sbody, srefs), ('support body not exact', symbol, hex(value))
            if depth < 3:
                sv, _ = bind_value(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, bodies, symbol, sbody, starget, value, own,
                                   record, depth + 1)
                support_out.setdefault(symbol, {'address': '%08x' % value, 'verified_targets': sv})
            how = 'support body exact at the bound address'
        elif symbol.startswith('?prime_list@') and 'next_prime@bucket_array_base@' in symbol:
            assert value == 0x824988, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'boost prime table (checked by bytes)'
        elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
            how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
        elif LOCAL_STATIC.match(symbol) and symbol in LOCAL_STATIC_AT:
            assert LOCAL_STATIC_AT[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(LOCAL_STATIC_AT[symbol]))
            how = 'local static'
        elif LOCAL_STATIC.match(symbol) and '?1???$get@UTimeStamp@@' in symbol:
            # the index static of get<TimeStamp> (value 00971a84) and its guard (00971a88): one address per symbol
            how = 'local static (get<TimeStamp> index)'
            expected = 0x971a88 if symbol.startswith('?$S') else 0x971a84
            assert value == expected, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(expected))
        else:
            UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
            continue
        if record:
            prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
            assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
        verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
    return verified, local


def verify(which, rows, own, strict=True, record=True):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict or DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        verified, local = bind_value(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, bodies, name, body, target, address, own, record)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def original_slots(vt):
    n = 0
    while TEXT[0] <= d(vt + 4 * n) < TEXT[1]:
        n += 1
    return n


def vtable_slots(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, index = definitions[symbol]
    section = sections[index]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(section[7]):
        offset, sym, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, section[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start and kind == 6:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[sym][0]
    return slots

    slots = vtable_slots(OBJ['cur'], symbol)
    count = original_slots(vt)
    assert len(slots) == count == 1, (symbol, slots, count)
    entries = {}
    for slot, name in sorted(slots.items()):
        value = d(vt + 4 * slot)
        assert name.startswith('??_E') and own.get('??_G' + name[4:]) == value, (symbol, slot, name, hex(value))
        entries[slot] = '%s -> %s (own row ??_G)' % (name, hex(value))
    vtables.append({'vtable': hex(vt), 'symbol': symbol, 'rtti': rtti, 'original_slots': count, 'slots': entries})


def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            rows = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk(data.get('methods', []))
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = list(rows)
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault('%08x' % int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

        return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
    if symbol == '__TI2?AVbad_alloc@std@@':
        # std::_Allocate's throw info: its catchable type array names bad_alloc then exception
        catchable = d(value + 12)
        names = [original.string(d(d(catchable + 4 + 4 * i) + 4) + 8) for i in range(d(catchable))]
        assert names == ['.?AVbad_alloc@std@@', '.?AVexception@std@@'], (where, hex(value), names)
        return 'throw info (catchable types %s)' % ', '.join(names)
    if symbol in own:
        assert own[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
        return 'own row'
    if symbol in EXTERNAL:
        assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
        return 'external'
    if EVIDENCE.get('%08x' % value, {}).get('symbol') == symbol:
        return 'evidence name'
    return instance(symbol, value, where)


def instance(symbol, value, where):
    """A body this unit (or the sender-unit evidence build) emits, proven by its bytes at the called address and by
    its own targets. Never counted."""
    if symbol in INSTANCES:
        assert INSTANCES[symbol]['address'] == hex(value), (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'instance (%s)' % INSTANCES[symbol]['build']
    for obj in (unit_obj, evidence_obj):
        if symbol not in bodies_of(obj):
            continue
        body = bodies_of(obj)[symbol][0]
        target = original.data(value, len(body))
        refs = bodies_of(obj)[symbol][1]
        mask = {r + k for r in refs for k in range(4)}
        if any(body[i] != target[i] for i in range(len(body)) if i not in mask):
            continue
        build_name = 'unit build' if obj == unit_obj else 'sender-unit evidence build'
        INSTANCES[symbol] = {'address': hex(value), 'build': build_name}
        row = verify(obj, [((value, 0, len(body), 'raw'), symbol)], False)[0]
        listed = FUNCS.get(value, {}).get('size')
        row.update({'address': hex(value), 'build': build_name, 'listed_size': listed,
                    'status': 'instance: bytes equal at the called address (relocations masked) in the %s, every own '
                              'target verified; not counted here' % build_name})
        INSTANCES[symbol] = row
        return 'instance (%s)' % build_name
    raise AssertionError(('unbound target', where, symbol, hex(value)))


def verify(obj, specs, exact_flag):
    CURRENT.append(obj)
    try:
        raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
        sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
        out = []
        for spec, name in specs:
            body, refs = bodies_of(obj)[name]
            address, lo, hi = spec[:3]
            body, refs = body[lo:hi], [r - lo for r in refs if lo <= r < hi]
            if spec[3:] == ('raw',):
                target, target_refs = original.data(address, len(body)), []
                mask = {r + k for r in refs for k in range(4)}
                assert all(body[i] == target[i] for i in range(len(body)) if i not in mask), (name, hex(address))
            else:
                target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
                assert match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs), (name, hex(address), len(body), len(target))
            start, section = definitions[name]
            start += lo
            table = sections[section]
            code = raw[table[4] + start:]
            verified, local = {}, set()
            for i in range(table[7]):
                offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
                offset -= start
                if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                    continue
                symbol = symbols[index][0]
                if kind == 20:
                    value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
                else:
                    value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0]
                             - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
                if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                    local.add(symbol)
                    continue
                how = classify(symbol, value, raw, sections, definitions, name)
                prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, value)
                assert prev == value, ('inconsistent binding', symbol, hex(prev), hex(value))
                verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
            whole = (lo, hi) == (0, len(bodies_of(obj)[name][0]))
            out.append({'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name + ('' if whole else ' [%#x:%#x]' % (lo, hi)),
                        'size': len(body), 'exact': exact_flag, 'verified_targets': verified,
                        'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        return out
    finally:
        CURRENT.pop()

                if isinstance(data.get(key), (list, dict)):
                    rows_ = list(data[key])
                    break
            else:
                def walk(o):
                    if isinstance(o, list):
                        for e in o:
                            walk(e)
                    elif isinstance(o, dict):
                        if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                            rows_.append(o['address'])

def reloc_values(raw, symbol, address, target_code):
    """[(offset, kind, symbol, original value)] for every relocation of the compiled `symbol`."""
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[section]
    code = raw[table[4] + start:]
    out = []
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        offset -= start
        if not 0 <= offset < len(target_code):
            continue
        name = symbols[index][0]
        if kind == 20:
            value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target_code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        else:
            value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target_code, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        out.append((offset, 'REL32' if kind == 20 else 'DIR32', name, value))
    return out

def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        found = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            found = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            found = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            found = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        found.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk(data.get('methods', []))
        if isinstance(found, dict):
            found = list(found)
        for r in found:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault('%08x' % int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

def target_of(address):

def joined_target(rows):

class Closure:
    def __init__(self, roots):
        self.bodies = load_bodies()
        self.raw = Path(OBJ).read_bytes()
        self.index = match._coff_data_index(self.raw)
        self.used, self.unbound = set(), []
        self.proven, self.aliases, self.why, self.not_exact = {}, {}, {}, {}
        self.data_checked = {}
        queue = deque()
        for address, pattern, evidence in roots:
            hits = [n for n in self.bodies if not nb.LOCAL_EH.match(n) and all(p in n for p in pattern)]
            assert len(hits) == 1, ('root pattern must select one symbol', pattern, hits)
            queue.append((address, hits[0], 'root: ' + evidence))
        while queue:
            address, symbol, reason = queue.popleft()
            if address in self.proven:
                if symbol not in self.aliases[address]:
                    assert self.exact_at(symbol, address), ('folded alias not exact', '%08x' % address, symbol)
                    self.aliases[address].append(symbol)
                continue
            if not self.exact_at(symbol, address):
                self.not_exact.setdefault(address, (symbol, reason))
                continue
            self.proven[address], self.aliases[address], self.why[address] = symbol, [symbol], reason
            _, _, rel = self.bodies[symbol]
            target, _ = target_of(address)
            for offset, sym, kind in rel:
                if kind == 20:
                    value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
                    if value in FUNCTIONS and sym in self.bodies and not nb.LOCAL_EH.match(sym) \
                            and sym not in EXTERNAL and sym not in JOINED:
                        queue.append((value, sym, 'called by %08x' % address))
        self.own = {}
        for address, syms in self.aliases.items():
            for s in syms:
                prev = self.own.setdefault(s, address)
                assert prev == address, ('one address per symbol', s, hex(prev), hex(address))
        self.joined = {}
        for sym, rows in JOINED.items():
            body, refs, _ = self.bodies[sym]
            target, target_refs = joined_target(rows)
            assert len(target) == len(body) and match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs), ('joined', sym)
            self.joined[sym] = rows[0]
        self.checked = {a: self.verify(a, s) for a, s in sorted(self.proven.items())}

    def exact_at(self, symbol, address):
        if symbol not in self.bodies or address not in FUNCTIONS:
            return False
        body, refs, _ = self.bodies[symbol]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        return match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)

    def resolve(self, owner, sym, value):
        """Verify one relocation target; returns a description or None (unbound)."""
        sections, symbols, definitions, _ = self.index
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(sym), (owner, sym, hex(value), hit)
            return '%s!%s' % hit
        if sym.startswith('__real@'):
            assert original.data(value, len(sym[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(sym[7:])[::-1], (owner, sym)
            return 'constant %s' % sym[7:]
        if sym.startswith('??_C@'):
            pos, at = definitions[sym]
            literal = self.raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
            assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (owner, sym, hex(value))
            return 'string %r' % literal[:-1].decode('latin-1')
        if sym.startswith('??_7'):
            rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
            cls = sym[4:sym.index('@@6B') + 2]
            assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (owner, sym, hex(value), rtti)
            return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
        if sym.startswith('??_R0'):
            name = '.' + sym[5:-2]
            assert original.string(value + 8) == name, (owner, sym, hex(value), original.string(value + 8))
            return 'type descriptor %s' % name
        if 'stored_vtable' in sym:
            return self.verify_table(owner, sym, value)
        if sym in self.own:
            assert self.own[sym] == value, (owner, sym, hex(value), hex(self.own[sym]))
            return 'own row'
        if sym in self.joined:
            assert self.joined[sym] == value, (owner, sym, hex(value))
            return 'joined rows (bounds evidence)'
        if sym in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[sym] == value, (owner, sym, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[sym]))
            self.used.add(sym)
            return 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == sym else '')
        return None

    def verify_table(self, owner, sym, value):
        """A constant boost.function manager table: bytes equal and every slot one of the proven rows."""
        if sym in self.data_checked:
            assert self.data_checked[sym][0] == value, (owner, sym, hex(value))
            return self.data_checked[sym][1]
        sections, symbols, definitions, _ = self.index
        pos, at = definitions[sym]
        table = sections[at]
        size = table[3] - pos
        mine = self.raw[table[4] + pos:table[4] + table[3]]
        theirs = original.data(value, size)
        slots = []
        masked = set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', self.raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= pos
            if not 0 <= offset < size:
                continue
            assert kind == 6, (sym, kind)
            target = struct.unpack_from('<I', theirs, offset)[0]
            slot = symbols[index][0]
            how = self.resolve(sym, slot, target)
            if how is None:
                self.unbound.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in table %s" % (slot, target, names.get(target, '')[:50],
                                                                      sym[:50]))
                how = 'UNBOUND'
            slots.append('%s -> %#x (%s)' % (slot[:60], target, how))
            masked.update(range(offset, offset + 4))
        assert all(mine[k] == theirs[k] for k in range(size) if k not in masked), (owner, sym)
        how = 'manager table (%s)' % '; '.join(slots)
        self.data_checked[sym] = (value, how)
        return how

    def verify(self, address, symbol):
        body, refs, rel = self.bodies[symbol]
        target, _ = target_of(address)
        sections, symbols, definitions, _ = self.index
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for offset, sym, kind in rel:
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                start, section = definitions[symbol]
                code = self.raw[sections[section][4] + start:]
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) \
                    & 0xffffffff
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(sym):
                local.add(sym)
                continue
            how = self.resolve(symbol, sym, value)
            if how is None:
                self.unbound.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s at %08x" % (sym, value, names.get(value, '')[:50],
                                                                          symbol[:50], address + offset))
                continue
            verified[sym] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        return {'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)}

    def check(self):
        if DISCOVER:
            print('\n'.join(sorted(set(self.unbound))))
            for a, (s, r) in sorted(self.not_exact.items()):

            for a in sorted(self.proven):

            print('UNUSED EXTERNAL', sorted(set(EXTERNAL) - self.used))

                    for e in o:

def check_body(unit, address, name, row):
    body, refs = unit.bodies[name]
    target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
    start, section = unit.definitions[name]
    table = unit.sections[section]
    code = unit.raw[table[4] + start:]
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', unit.raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        offset -= start
        if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
            continue
        symbol = unit.symbols[index][0]
        if kind == 20:
            value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        else:
            value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) \
                & 0xffffffff
        where = '%08x+%#x' % (address, offset)
        if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            row['local_eh'].append(symbol)
            continue
        how = classify(unit, symbol, value, where)
        if how is None:
            UNBOUND.append((where, symbol, hex(value), names.get(value, '')[:80]))
            continue
        bind(symbol, value, where)
        row['verified_targets'][symbol] = '%#x (%s)' % (value, how)

def compiled_vtables(unit):
    out = {}
    for name, (start, sec) in unit.definitions.items():
        if not name.startswith('??_7'):
            continue
        table = unit.sections[sec]
        end = min([x for x in unit.starts.get(sec + 1, ()) if x > start] + [table[3]])

def load_bodies(obj):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {}
    for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw):
        start, section = definitions[n]
        table = sections[section]
        rel = []
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if 0 <= offset < len(b):
                rel.append((offset, symbols[index][0], kind))
        bodies.setdefault(n, (b, r, rel))
    return bodies

def target_of(address):
    if address not in TARGET:
        body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        TARGET[address] = (body, refs)
    return TARGET[address]


class Closure:
    """Proves rows of one object by call-graph closure; verification runs later against the shared OWN map."""

    def __init__(self, key, roots):
        self.key = key
        self.obj = OBJ[key]
        self.bodies = load_bodies(self.obj)
        self.raw = Path(self.obj).read_bytes()
        self.index = match._coff_data_index(self.raw)
        self.unbound = []
        self.proven, self.aliases, self.why, self.not_exact = {}, {}, {}, {}
        queue = deque()
        for obj_key, address, pattern, evidence in roots:
            if obj_key != key:
                continue
            hits = [n for n in self.bodies if not nb.LOCAL_EH.match(n) and n.startswith(pattern[0])
                    and all(p in n for p in pattern[1:])]
            assert len(hits) == 1, ('root pattern must select one symbol', pattern, hits)
            queue.append((address, hits[0], 'root: ' + evidence))
        while queue:
            address, symbol, reason = queue.popleft()
            if address in self.proven:
                if symbol not in self.aliases[address]:
                    assert self.exact_at(symbol, address), ('folded alias not exact', '%08x' % address, symbol)
                    self.aliases[address].append(symbol)
                continue
            if not self.exact_at(symbol, address):
                self.not_exact.setdefault(address, (symbol, reason))
                continue
            self.proven[address], self.aliases[address], self.why[address] = symbol, [symbol], reason
            _, _, rel = self.bodies[symbol]
            target, _ = target_of(address)
            for offset, sym, kind in rel:
                if kind == 20:
                    value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
                    if value in FUNCTIONS and sym in self.bodies and not nb.LOCAL_EH.match(sym) \
                            and sym not in EXTERNAL:
                        queue.append((value, sym, 'called by %08x' % address))

    def exact_at(self, symbol, address):
        if symbol not in self.bodies or address not in FUNCTIONS:
            return False
        body, refs, _ = self.bodies[symbol]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        return len(target) == len(body) and match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)

    def resolve(self, owner, sym, value):
        """Verify one relocation target; returns a description or None (unbound)."""
        sections, symbols, definitions, _ = self.index
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(sym), (owner, sym, hex(value), hit)
            return '%s!%s' % hit
        if sym.startswith('__real@'):
            assert original.data(value, len(sym[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(sym[7:])[::-1], (owner, sym)
            return 'constant %s' % sym[7:]
        if sym.startswith('??_C@'):
            pos, at = definitions[sym]
            literal = self.raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
            assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (owner, sym, hex(value))
            return 'string %r' % literal[:-1].decode('latin-1')[:60]
        if sym.startswith('??_7'):
            rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
            cls = sym[4:sym.index('@@6B') + 2]
            assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (owner, sym, hex(value), rtti)
            return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x; %s' % (rtti, at, self.verify_vtable(owner, sym, value))
        if sym.startswith('??_R0'):
            name = '.' + sym[5:-2]
            assert original.string(value + 8) == name, (owner, sym, hex(value), original.string(value + 8))
            return 'type descriptor %s' % name
        if sym in OWN:
            assert OWN[sym] == value, (owner, sym, hex(value), hex(OWN[sym]))
            return 'own row'
        if sym in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[sym] == value, (owner, sym, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[sym]))
            USED.add(sym)
            return 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == sym else '')
        return None

    def verify_vtable(self, owner, sym, value):
        """Compare the compiled vtable slot by slot with the original one (each slot resolved like a call target)."""
        if sym in VTABLES:
            assert VTABLES[sym][0] == value, (owner, sym, hex(value))
            return VTABLES[sym][1]
        sections, symbols, definitions, _ = self.index
        pos, at = definitions[sym]
        table = sections[at]
        slots = []
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', self.raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= pos
            if offset < 0:
                continue
            assert kind == 6 and offset % 4 == 0, (sym, kind, offset)
            slot = symbols[index][0]
            original_slot = struct.unpack('<I', original.data(value + offset, 4))[0]
            scalar = '??_G' + slot[4:] if slot.startswith('??_E') else None
            if scalar in OWN and slot not in self.bodies:
                # the vector deleting destructor slot resolves to the scalar one (no array new of the class)
                assert OWN[scalar] == original_slot, (sym, slot, hex(original_slot))
                how = 'own row %s (??_E resolved to ??_G)' % scalar[:40]
            else:
                how = self.resolve(sym, slot, original_slot)
            if how is None:
                self.unbound.append("    %r: %#x,   # vtable %s slot %d" % (slot, original_slot, sym[:40], offset // 4))
                how = 'UNBOUND'
            slots.append('slot %d %s -> %#x (%s)' % (offset // 4, slot[:60], original_slot, how))
        VTABLES[sym] = (value, 'slots: ' + '; '.join(slots))
        return VTABLES[sym][1]

    def verify(self, address, symbol):
        body, refs, rel = self.bodies[symbol]
        target, _ = target_of(address)
        sections, symbols, definitions, _ = self.index
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for offset, sym, kind in rel:
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                start, section = definitions[symbol]
                code = self.raw[sections[section][4] + start:]
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) \
                    & 0xffffffff
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(sym):
                local.add(sym)
                continue
            how = self.resolve(symbol, sym, value)
            if how is None:
                self.unbound.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s at %08x" % (sym, value, names.get(value, '')[:50],
                                                                          symbol[:50], address + offset))
                continue
            verified[sym] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        return {'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)}

def verify(address, symbol):
    which, body, refs, rel = BODIES[symbol]
    target, target_refs = target_of(address)
    verified, local = {}, set()
    for offset, sym, kind in rel:
        if kind == 20:
            value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        else:
            raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
            sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
            start, section = definitions[symbol]
            code = raw[sections[section][4] + start:]
            value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(sym):
            local.add(sym)
            continue
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(sym), (symbol, sym, hex(value), hit)
            how = '%s!%s' % hit
        elif sym.startswith('__real@'):
            assert original.data(value, len(sym[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(sym[7:])[::-1], (symbol, sym, hex(value))
            how = 'constant %s' % sym[7:]
        elif sym.startswith('??_C@'):
            raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
            sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
            pos, at = definitions[sym]
            literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
            assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (symbol, sym, hex(value))
            how = 'string %r' % literal[:-1].decode('latin-1')
        elif sym.startswith('??_7'):
            rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
            cls = sym[4:sym.index('@@6B') + 2]
            assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (symbol, sym, hex(value), rtti)
            how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
        elif sym in own:
            assert own[sym] == value, (symbol, sym, hex(value), hex(own[sym]))
            how = 'own row'
        elif sym in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[sym] == value, (symbol, sym, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[sym]))
            how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == sym else '')
            USED_EXTERNAL.add(sym)
        else:
            UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s at %08x" % (sym, value, names.get(value, '')[:50], symbol[:50],
                                                                address + offset))
            continue
        verified[sym] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
    return {'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)}

def concatenated_target(parts):
    """Original bytes and relocation offsets of consecutive analysed rows, joined (bounds evidence only)."""
    data, relocs, start = b'', [], parts[0]
    for a in parts:

def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            rows = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk(data.get('methods', []))
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = list(rows)
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault(int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

def load_bodies(which):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {}
    for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw):
        start, section = definitions[n]
        table = sections[section]
        rel = []
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if 0 <= offset < len(b):
                rel.append((offset, symbols[index][0], kind))
        bodies.setdefault(n, (which, b, r, rel))
    return bodies

def target_of(address):
    if address not in TARGET:
        body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        TARGET[address] = (body, refs)
    return TARGET[address]


class Closure:
    def __init__(self, which, roots, external, data_external):
        self.which, self.external, self.data_external = which, external, data_external
        self.bodies = load_bodies(which)
        self.raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
        self.index = match._coff_data_index(self.raw)
        self.used, self.unbound = set(), []
        self.proven, self.aliases, self.why, self.not_exact = {}, {}, {}, {}
        queue = deque()
        for address, symbol, evidence in roots:
            assert symbol in self.bodies, ('root symbol missing', which, symbol)
            if not self.exact_at(symbol, address):
                self.not_exact[address] = (symbol, 'root: ' + evidence)
                continue
            queue.append((address, symbol, 'root: ' + evidence))
        while queue:
            address, symbol, reason = queue.popleft()
            if address in self.proven:
                if symbol not in self.aliases[address]:
                    assert self.exact_at(symbol, address), ('folded alias not exact', '%08x' % address, symbol)
                    self.aliases[address].append(symbol)
                continue
            if not self.exact_at(symbol, address):
                self.not_exact.setdefault(address, (symbol, reason))
                continue
            self.proven[address], self.aliases[address], self.why[address] = symbol, [symbol], reason
            _, body, _, rel = self.bodies[symbol]
            target, _ = target_of(address)
            for offset, sym, kind in rel:
                if kind == 20:
                    value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
                    if value in FUNCTIONS and sym in self.bodies and not nb.LOCAL_EH.match(sym) \
                            and sym not in self.external:
                        queue.append((value, sym, 'called by %08x' % address))
        self.own = {}
        for address, syms in self.aliases.items():
            for s in syms:
                prev = self.own.setdefault(s, address)
                assert prev == address, ('one address per symbol', s, hex(prev), hex(address))
        self.checked = {a: self.verify(a, s) for a, s in sorted(self.proven.items())}

    def exact_at(self, symbol, address):
        if symbol not in self.bodies or address not in FUNCTIONS:
            return False
        _, body, refs, _ = self.bodies[symbol]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        return match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)

    def verify(self, address, symbol):
        _, body, refs, rel = self.bodies[symbol]
        target, _ = target_of(address)
        sections, symbols, definitions, _ = self.index
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for offset, sym, kind in rel:
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                start, section = definitions[symbol]
                code = self.raw[sections[section][4] + start:]
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) \
                    & 0xffffffff
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(sym):
                local.add(sym)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(sym), (symbol, sym, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif sym.startswith('__real@'):
                assert original.data(value, len(sym[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(sym[7:])[::-1], (symbol, sym)
                how = 'constant %s' % sym[7:]
            elif sym.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[sym]
                literal = self.raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (symbol, sym, hex(value))
                how = 'string %r' % literal[:-1].decode('latin-1')
            elif sym.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = sym[4:sym.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (symbol, sym, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif sym in self.own:
                assert self.own[sym] == value, (symbol, sym, hex(value), hex(self.own[sym]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif sym in self.external:
                assert self.external[sym] == value, (symbol, sym, hex(value), hex(self.external[sym]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == sym else '')
                self.used.add(sym)
            else:
                self.unbound.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s at %08x" % (sym, value, names.get(value, '')[:50],
                                                                          symbol[:50], address + offset))
                continue
            verified[sym] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        return {'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)}

    def check(self, label, required_unused=()):
        if DISCOVER:

            print('\n'.join(sorted(set(self.unbound))))
            for a, (s, r) in sorted(self.not_exact.items()):
