            print('PROVEN', len(self.proven), 'in range', sum(1 for a in self.proven if RANGE[0] <= a < RANGE[1]))
            print('UNUSED EXTERNAL', sorted(set(self.external) - self.used - set(required_unused)))
            return
        assert not self.unbound, '\n'.join(self.unbound)
        assert sorted(self.used | set(required_unused)) == sorted(self.external), \
            sorted(set(self.external) - self.used - set(required_unused))
        for symbol, address in self.external.items():
            assert address in FUNCTIONS or original.imported(address) is not None or symbol in self.data_external, \

def bind_value(which, name, body, target, address, own, record=True):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[name]
    table = sections[section]
    code = raw[table[4] + start:]
    verified, local = {}, set()
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        offset -= start
        if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
            continue
        symbol = symbols[index][0]
        if kind == 20:
            value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        else:
            value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            local.add(symbol)
            continue
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
            how = '%s!%s' % hit
        elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
            assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
        elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
            pos, at = definitions[symbol]
            literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
            assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'string %r' % literal[:-1].decode('latin-1')[:40]
        elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
            rtti = original.string(value + 8)
            assert rtti == '.' + symbol[5:-2], (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            how = 'RTTI type %s' % rtti
        elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
            rtti, offset_in_object = original.vtable_class(value)
            cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
            if rtti != '.?AV' + cls:
                UNBOUND.append('    vtable RTTI mismatch %s at %#x is %s (in %s)' % (symbol[:80], value, rtti, name[:60]))
                continue
            how = 'vtable (RTTI %s, offset %#x)' % (rtti, offset_in_object)
        elif symbol in ALIAS:
            assert ALIAS[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(ALIAS[symbol]))
            how = 'ICF-folded body (alias of a row proven here)'
        elif symbol in own:
            assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
            how = 'own row'
        elif support_key(symbol):
            assert SUPPORT[support_key(symbol)] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            sbody, srefs = BODIES[which][symbol]
            starget, strefs = target_of(value)
            assert match.exact_match(starget, strefs, sbody, srefs), ('support body not exact', symbol, hex(value))
            support_out[symbol] = '%#x' % value
            how = 'support body exact at the bound address'
        elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
            how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
        elif symbol in LOCAL_STATIC_AT:
            assert LOCAL_STATIC_AT[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(LOCAL_STATIC_AT[symbol]))

        else:
            UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))

        if record:

        verified[symbol] = '%#x (%s)' % (value, how)

    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = BODIES[which][name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict or DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        verified, local = bind_value(which, name, body, target, address, own, record)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def counted_elsewhere():

    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:

        try:

        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:

            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():

            walk(data.get('methods', []))

            if m:

def recorder_tables(path, wanted, constants):
    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())
    env = dict(constants)
    out = {}
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):

            if name in constants or name in wanted:
                value = eval(compile(ast.Expression(node.value), str(path), 'eval'), {'__builtins__': {}}, env)
                env[name] = value
                if name in wanted and name not in out:
                    out[name] = value
    assert sorted(out) == sorted(wanted), (path.name, sorted(set(wanted) - set(out)))
    return out

TARGET = {}


def target_of(address):
    if address not in TARGET:
        if address in JOINS:
            data, relocs = b'', []
            for a in (address, JOINS[address]):
                body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % a)
                assert address + len(data) == a, ('rows not contiguous', hex(a))
                relocs += [r + len(data) for r in refs]
                data += body
            TARGET[address] = (data, relocs)
        else:
            body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
            TARGET[address] = (body, refs)
    return TARGET[address]


def load_bodies(keys):
    bodies = {}
    for key in keys:
        raw = Path(OBJ[key]).read_bytes()
        sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
        for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw):
            start, section = definitions[n]
            table = sections[section]
            rel = []
            for i in range(table[7]):
                offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
                offset -= start
                if 0 <= offset < len(b):
                    rel.append((offset, symbols[index][0], kind))
            bodies.setdefault(n, (key, b, r, rel))
    return bodies


INDEX = {k: (Path(v).read_bytes(), match._coff_data_index(Path(v).read_bytes())) for k, v in OBJ.items()}


class Closure:
    def __init__(self, keys, roots, external, data_external):
        self.external, self.data_external = external, data_external
        self.bodies = load_bodies(keys)
        self.used, self.unbound = set(), []
        self.proven, self.aliases, self.why, self.not_exact = {}, {}, {}, {}
        queue = deque()
        for address, symbol, evidence in roots:
            assert symbol in self.bodies, ('root symbol missing', symbol)
            queue.append((address, symbol, 'root: ' + evidence))
        while queue:
            address, symbol, reason = queue.popleft()
            if address in self.proven:
                if symbol not in self.aliases[address]:
                    assert self.exact_at(symbol, address), ('folded alias not exact', '%08x' % address, symbol)
                    self.aliases[address].append(symbol)
                continue
            if not self.exact_at(symbol, address):
                self.not_exact.setdefault(address, (symbol, reason))
                continue
            self.proven[address], self.aliases[address], self.why[address] = symbol, [symbol], reason
            _, body, _, rel = self.bodies[symbol]
            target, _ = target_of(address)
            for offset, sym, kind in rel:
                if kind == 20:
                    value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
                    if value in FUNCTIONS and sym in self.bodies and not nb.LOCAL_EH.match(sym):
                        queue.append((value, sym, 'called by %08x' % address))
        self.own = {}
        for address, syms in self.aliases.items():
            for s in syms:
                prev = self.own.setdefault(s, address)
                assert prev == address, ('one address per symbol', s, hex(prev), hex(address))
        self.checked = {a: self.verify(a, s) for a, s in sorted(self.proven.items())}

    def exact_at(self, symbol, address):
        if symbol not in self.bodies or address not in FUNCTIONS:
            return False
        _, body, refs, _ = self.bodies[symbol]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        return len(target) == len(body) and match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)

    def verify(self, address, symbol):
        which, body, refs, rel = self.bodies[symbol]
        target, _ = target_of(address)
        raw, (sections, symbols, definitions, _) = INDEX[which]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for offset, sym, kind in rel:
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                start, section = definitions[symbol]
                code = raw[sections[section][4] + start:]
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) \
                    & 0xffffffff
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(sym) or sym.startswith('__tryend$'):
                local.add(sym)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(sym), (symbol, sym, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif sym.startswith('__real@'):
                assert original.data(value, len(sym[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(sym[7:])[::-1], (symbol, sym)
                how = 'constant %s' % sym[7:]
            elif sym.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[sym]
                literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (symbol, sym, hex(value))
                how = 'string %r' % literal[:-1].decode('latin-1')
            elif sym.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = sym[4:sym.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (symbol, sym, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif sym in self.own:
                assert self.own[sym] == value, (symbol, sym, hex(value), hex(self.own[sym]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif sym in self.external and (self.external[sym] == value or not DISCOVER):
                assert self.external[sym] == value, (symbol, sym, hex(value), hex(self.external[sym]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == sym else '')
                self.used.add(sym)
            else:
                self.unbound.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s at %08x" % (sym, value, names.get(value, '')[:50],
                                                                          symbol[:50], address + offset))
                continue
            verified[sym] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        return {'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)}

    def check(self, label):
        if DISCOVER:
            print('==', label)
            print('\n'.join(sorted(set(self.unbound))))
            for a, (s, r) in sorted(self.not_exact.items()):
                print('NOT EXACT %08x %s (%s)' % (a, s[:140], r))
            print('PROVEN', len(self.proven), 'in range', sorted('%08x' % a for a in self.proven if RANGE[0] <= a < RANGE[1]))
            return
        assert not self.unbound, '\n'.join(self.unbound)
        for symbol in self.used:
            address = self.external[symbol]
            assert address in FUNCTIONS or original.imported(address) is not None or symbol in self.data_external, \
                (symbol, hex(address))

def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            rows = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk(data.get('methods', []))
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = list(rows)
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault(int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

def load_bodies():
    raw = Path(OBJ).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {}
    for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw):
        start, section = definitions[n]
        table = sections[section]
        rel = []
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if 0 <= offset < len(b):
                rel.append((offset, symbols[index][0], kind))
        bodies.setdefault(n, (b, r, rel))
    return bodies


TARGET = {}


def target_of(address):
    if address not in TARGET:
        body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
        TARGET[address] = (body, refs)
    return TARGET[address]


def joined_target(rows):
    body, refs = b'', []
    for a in rows:
        t, r = target_of(a)
        refs += [x + len(body) for x in r] if r and isinstance(r[0], int) else list(r)
        body += t
    return body, refs


class Closure:
    def __init__(self, roots):
        self.bodies = load_bodies()
        self.raw = Path(OBJ).read_bytes()
        self.index = match._coff_data_index(self.raw)
        self.used, self.unbound = set(), []
        self.proven, self.aliases, self.why, self.not_exact = {}, {}, {}, {}
        self.data_checked = {}
        queue = deque()
        for address, pattern, evidence in roots:
            hits = [n for n in self.bodies if not nb.LOCAL_EH.match(n) and all(p in n for p in pattern)]
            assert len(hits) == 1, ('root pattern must select one symbol', pattern, hits)
            queue.append((address, hits[0], 'root: ' + evidence))
        while queue:
            address, symbol, reason = queue.popleft()
            if address in self.proven:
                if symbol not in self.aliases[address]:
                    assert self.exact_at(symbol, address), ('folded alias not exact', '%08x' % address, symbol)
                    self.aliases[address].append(symbol)
                continue
            if not self.exact_at(symbol, address):
                self.not_exact.setdefault(address, (symbol, reason))
                continue
            self.proven[address], self.aliases[address], self.why[address] = symbol, [symbol], reason
            _, _, rel = self.bodies[symbol]
            target, _ = target_of(address)
            for offset, sym, kind in rel:
                if kind == 20:
                    value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
                    if value in FUNCTIONS and sym in self.bodies and not nb.LOCAL_EH.match(sym) \
                            and sym not in EXTERNAL and sym not in JOINED:
                        queue.append((value, sym, 'called by %08x' % address))
        self.own = {}
        for address, syms in self.aliases.items():
            for s in syms:
                prev = self.own.setdefault(s, address)
                assert prev == address, ('one address per symbol', s, hex(prev), hex(address))
        self.joined = {}
        for sym, rows in JOINED.items():
            body, refs, _ = self.bodies[sym]
            target, target_refs = joined_target(rows)
            assert len(target) == len(body) and match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs), ('joined', sym)
            self.joined[sym] = rows[0]
        self.checked = {a: self.verify(a, s) for a, s in sorted(self.proven.items())}

    def exact_at(self, symbol, address):
        if symbol not in self.bodies or address not in FUNCTIONS:
            return False
        body, refs, _ = self.bodies[symbol]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        return match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)

    def resolve(self, owner, sym, value):
        """Verify one relocation target; returns a description or None (unbound)."""
        sections, symbols, definitions, _ = self.index
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(sym), (owner, sym, hex(value), hit)
            return '%s!%s' % hit
        if sym.startswith('__real@'):
            assert original.data(value, len(sym[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(sym[7:])[::-1], (owner, sym)
            return 'constant %s' % sym[7:]
        if sym.startswith('??_C@'):
            pos, at = definitions[sym]
            literal = self.raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
            assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (owner, sym, hex(value))
            return 'string %r' % literal[:-1].decode('latin-1')
        if sym.startswith('??_7'):
            rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
            cls = sym[4:sym.index('@@6B') + 2]
            assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (owner, sym, hex(value), rtti)
            return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
        if sym.startswith('??_R0'):
            name = '.' + sym[5:-2]
            assert original.string(value + 8) == name, (owner, sym, hex(value), original.string(value + 8))
            return 'type descriptor %s' % name
        if 'stored_vtable' in sym:
            return self.verify_table(owner, sym, value)
        if sym in self.own:
            assert self.own[sym] == value, (owner, sym, hex(value), hex(self.own[sym]))
            return 'own row'
        if sym in self.joined:
            assert self.joined[sym] == value, (owner, sym, hex(value))
            return 'joined rows (bounds evidence)'
        if sym in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[sym] == value, (owner, sym, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[sym]))
            self.used.add(sym)
            return 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == sym else '')
        return None

    def verify_table(self, owner, sym, value):
        """A constant boost.function manager table: bytes equal and every slot one of the proven rows."""
        if sym in self.data_checked:
            assert self.data_checked[sym][0] == value, (owner, sym, hex(value))
            return self.data_checked[sym][1]
        sections, symbols, definitions, _ = self.index
        pos, at = definitions[sym]
        table = sections[at]
        size = table[3] - pos
        mine = self.raw[table[4] + pos:table[4] + table[3]]
        theirs = original.data(value, size)
        slots = []
        masked = set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', self.raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= pos
            if not 0 <= offset < size:
                continue
            assert kind == 6, (sym, kind)
            target = struct.unpack_from('<I', theirs, offset)[0]
            slot = symbols[index][0]
            how = self.resolve(sym, slot, target)
            if how is None:
                self.unbound.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in table %s" % (slot, target, names.get(target, '')[:50],
                                                                      sym[:50]))
                how = 'UNBOUND'
            slots.append('%s -> %#x (%s)' % (slot[:60], target, how))
            masked.update(range(offset, offset + 4))
        assert all(mine[k] == theirs[k] for k in range(size) if k not in masked), (owner, sym)
        how = 'manager table (%s)' % '; '.join(slots)
        self.data_checked[sym] = (value, how)
        return how

    def verify(self, address, symbol):
        body, refs, rel = self.bodies[symbol]
        target, _ = target_of(address)
        sections, symbols, definitions, _ = self.index
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for offset, sym, kind in rel:
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                start, section = definitions[symbol]
                code = self.raw[sections[section][4] + start:]
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) \
                    & 0xffffffff
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(sym):
                local.add(sym)
                continue
            how = self.resolve(symbol, sym, value)
            if how is None:
                self.unbound.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s at %08x" % (sym, value, names.get(value, '')[:50],
                                                                          symbol[:50], address + offset))
                continue
            verified[sym] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        return {'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)}

    def check(self):
        if DISCOVER:
            print('\n'.join(sorted(set(self.unbound))))
            for a, (s, r) in sorted(self.not_exact.items()):
                print('NOT EXACT %08x %s (%s)' % (a, s[:120], r))
            for a in sorted(self.proven):
                print('PROVEN %08x %s %s' % (a, self.proven[a][:110], self.why[a][:40]))
            print('PROVEN', len(self.proven), 'in range', sum(1 for a in self.proven if RANGE[0] <= a < RANGE[1]))
            print('UNUSED EXTERNAL', sorted(set(EXTERNAL) - self.used))
            return
        assert not self.unbound, '\n'.join(self.unbound)
        assert sorted(self.used) == sorted(EXTERNAL), sorted(set(EXTERNAL) - self.used)
        assert not self.not_exact, {('%08x' % a): v for a, v in self.not_exact.items()}
        for symbol, address in EXTERNAL.items():
            assert address in FUNCTIONS or original.imported(address) is not None or symbol in DATA_EXTERNAL, \
                (symbol, hex(address))

def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            rows = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk(data.get('methods', []))
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = list(rows)
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault(int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

def bind_value(which, name, body, target, address, own, record=True):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[name]
    table = sections[section]
    code = raw[table[4] + start:]
    verified, local = {}, set()
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        offset -= start
        if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
            continue
        symbol = symbols[index][0]
        if kind == 20:
            value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        else:
            value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            local.add(symbol)
            continue
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
            how = '%s!%s' % hit
        elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
            assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
        elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
            pos, at = definitions[symbol]
            literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
            assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'string %r' % literal[:-1].decode('latin-1')[:40]
        elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
            rtti = original.string(value + 8)
            assert rtti == '.' + symbol[5:-2], (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            how = 'RTTI type %s' % rtti
        elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
            rtti, offset_in_object = original.vtable_class(value)
            cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
            if rtti != '.?AV' + cls:
                UNBOUND.append('    vtable RTTI mismatch %s at %#x is %s (in %s)' % (symbol[:80], value, rtti, name[:60]))
                continue
            how = 'vtable (RTTI %s, offset %#x)' % (rtti, offset_in_object)
        elif symbol in ALIAS:
            assert ALIAS[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(ALIAS[symbol]))
            how = 'ICF-folded body (alias of a row proven here)'
        elif symbol in own:
            assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
            how = 'own row'
        elif support_key(symbol):
            assert SUPPORT[support_key(symbol)] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            sbody, srefs = BODIES[which][symbol]
            starget, strefs = target_of(value)
            assert match.exact_match(starget, strefs, sbody, srefs), ('support body not exact', symbol, hex(value))
            support_out[symbol] = '%#x' % value
            how = 'support body exact at the bound address'
        elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
            how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
        elif symbol in LOCAL_STATIC_AT:
            assert LOCAL_STATIC_AT[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(LOCAL_STATIC_AT[symbol]))
            how = 'static data (one address per symbol)'
        else:
            UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
            continue
        if record:
            prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
            assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
        verified[symbol] = '%#x (%s)' % (value, how)

def verify(which, rows, own, strict=True, record=True):
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = BODIES[which][name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict or DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        verified, local = bind_value(which, name, body, target, address, own, record)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def referenced_here():
    """Symbols that some compiled function's relocations name (REL32 / DIR32)."""
    out = set()
    for name in BODIES:
        start, sec = DEFINITIONS[name]
        table = SECTIONS[sec]
        for i in range(table[7]):
            off, idx, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', RAW, table[5] + 10 * i)
            out.add(SYMBOLS[idx][0])
    return out

TARGETS = {}


def target(address):
    if address not in TARGETS:
        TARGETS[address] = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
    return TARGETS[address]


def exact_at(symbol, address):
    body, refs = BODIES[symbol]
    t, tr, _ = target(address)
    return bool(match.exact_match(t, tr, body, refs))


def resolve(address, prefixes):
    """The symbol compiled here for the row: byte-exact candidates among the prefixes; among folded duplicates, the
    one the compiled rows reference (or the first prefix when nothing references any)."""
    def ok(n, p):
        head, _, part = p.partition('|')
        return n.startswith(head) and part in n
    cands = [n for n in BODIES if any(ok(n, p) for p in prefixes)]
    good = [n for n in cands if exact_at(n, address)]
    if len(good) > 1:
        ref = [n for n in good if n in REFERENCED]
        good = ref if len(ref) == 1 else [n for n in (ref or good) if ok(n, prefixes[0])]
    if len(good) != 1:
        if DISCOVER:
            return None, cands
        raise AssertionError(('row', hex(address), prefixes[0][:60], cands[:6], good))
    return good[0], [n for n in cands if n != good[0] and exact_at(n, address)]

def bind(symbol, value, where):

def verify(rows):
    own = {s: a for a, s in rows}
    out = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = BODIES[name]
        t, tr, _ = target(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(t, tr, body, refs)
        row = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(t),
               'exact': bool(exact), 'verified_targets': {}, 'local_eh': [], 'unverified': []}
        out.append(row)
        if not exact:
            continue
        start, section = DEFINITIONS[name]
        table = SECTIONS[section]
        code = RAW[table[4] + start:]
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', RAW, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = SYMBOLS[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', t, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', t, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            where = '%08x+%#x' % (address, offset)
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                row['local_eh'].append(symbol)
                continue
            how = None
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = DEFINITIONS[symbol]
                literal = RAW[SECTIONS[at][4] + pos:SECTIONS[at][4] + SECTIONS[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (where, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'string %r' % literal[:-1].decode('latin-1')
            elif symbol.startswith('__TI') and symbol[4:5].isdigit():
                # ThrowInfo -> CatchableTypeArray (count, first CatchableType) -> TypeDescriptor name
                count = int(symbol[4])
                cta = d(value + 12)
                assert d(cta) == count, (where, symbol, hex(value), d(cta))
                tname = original.string(d(d(cta + 4) + 4) + 8)
                assert tname == '.' + symbol[5:], (where, symbol, hex(value), tname)
                how = 'ThrowInfo of %s (%d catchable types)' % (tname, count)
            elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
                rtti = original.string(value + 8)
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'RTTI %s' % rtti
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol in COUNTED_TARGETS:
                other, receipts = COUNTED_TARGETS[symbol]
                assert other == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(other))
                assert exact_at(symbol, value), ('counted-elsewhere body not exact', symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'row counted by %s (compiled body exact at the bound address)' % ', '.join(receipts)
            elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
            elif names.get(value, '') == symbol:
                how = 'external (evidence name)'
            elif symbol in DROPPED_SYMBOLS:
                row['unverified'].append('%s -> %#x: row not counted (%s)' % (symbol[:90], value,
                                                                              DROPPED_SYMBOLS[symbol]))
                continue
            elif symbol in BODIES:
                # helper / COMDAT body compiled here but not a row: exact at the bound address, never counted
                if not exact_at(symbol, value):
                    row['unverified'].append('%s -> %#x: the body compiled here is not exact there' % (
                        symbol[:90], value))
                    continue
                HELPERS.setdefault(symbol, '%#x' % value)
                how = 'helper body exact at the bound address (not counted)'
            elif symbol in DEFINITIONS and symbol not in BODIES:
                assert any(lo <= value < hi for lo, hi in DATA_SECTIONS), (where, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'own static (bound by consistency)'
            if how is None:
                UNBOUND.append((where, symbol, hex(value), names.get(value, '')[:80]))
                continue
            bind(symbol, value, where)
            row['verified_targets'][symbol] = '%#x (%s)' % (value, how)
    return out

def vtable_slots(vtable_address):
    out = {}
    for symbol, address in sorted(vtable_address.items()):
        start, sec = DEFINITIONS[symbol]
        table = SECTIONS[sec]
        relocs = sorted((struct.unpack_from('<IIH', RAW, table[5] + 10 * k)) for k in range(table[7]))
        slots = [(off - start, SYMBOLS[idx][0]) for off, idx, kind in relocs if kind == 6 and off >= start]
        slots = [x for x in slots if x[0] < table[3] - start]
        checked, unbound = [], []
        for off, slot_symbol in slots:
            value = d(address + off)
            if slot_symbol in BINDING:
                assert BINDING[slot_symbol][0] == value or DISCOVER, ('vtable slot', symbol, off // 4, slot_symbol,
                                                                      hex(value), hex(BINDING[slot_symbol][0]))
                checked.append('%d %s = %#x (bound by the rows)' % (off // 4, slot_symbol[:90], value))
            elif slot_symbol in BODIES:
                assert exact_at(slot_symbol, value) or DISCOVER, ('vtable slot body', symbol, off // 4, slot_symbol,
                                                                  hex(value))
                bind(slot_symbol, value, '%s slot %d' % (symbol[:40], off // 4))
                checked.append('%d %s = %#x (compiled body exact there)' % (off // 4, slot_symbol[:90], value))
            elif same_member(names.get(value, ''), slot_symbol):
                checked.append('%d %s = %#x (evidence name%s)' % (off // 4, slot_symbol[:90], value, '' if names.get(
                    value) == slot_symbol else ' up to the access letter: ' + names.get(value)[:90]))
            else:
                unbound.append('%d %s = %#x' % (off // 4, slot_symbol[:90], value))
        originals = [d(address + 4 * k) for k in range(len(slots) + 1)]
        in_text = [TEXT[0] <= v < TEXT[1] for v in originals]
        assert (all(in_text[:-1]) and not in_text[-1]) or DISCOVER, (
            'vtable slot count', symbol, hex(address), [hex(v) for v in originals])
        out[symbol] = {'address': '%#x' % address, 'rtti': original.vtable_class(address)[0], 'slots': len(slots),
                       'checked': checked, 'not_bound_here': unbound}
    return out

def holds_string(address, text):
    body = original.data(address, FUNCTIONS[address]['size'])
    for i in range(len(body) - 3):
        v = struct.unpack_from('<I', body, i)[0]
        if any(lo <= v < hi for lo, hi in DATA_SECTIONS):
            try:
                if original.string(v) == text:
                    return True
            except Exception:
                pass
    return False


def holds_vtable(address, prefix):
    body = original.data(address, FUNCTIONS[address]['size'])
    for i in range(len(body) - 3):
        v = struct.unpack_from('<I', body, i)[0]
        if 0x7f0000 <= v < 0x880000:
            try:
                c = original.vtable_class(v)
            except Exception:
                continue
            if c and c[0] and c[0][4:].startswith(prefix[4:]):
                return True
    return False

    out = {}

        for key in ('exact_function_rows', 'exact_addresses', 'exact_unique_addresses', 'exact_distinct_addresses'):
            if isinstance(data.get(key), (list, dict)):
                found = list(data[key])
                break
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        found.append(o['address'])

            if m:

def bind(symbol, value, where):

def is_catch_funclet(address):
    # catch(...) { delete p; throw; } funclet of the boost shared_count constructors: the deleter call on the
    # [ebp + 8] pointer, then push 0; push 0; call _CxxThrowException (006a158c) as the last instruction
    row = FUNCTIONS.get(address)
    if not row or not 16 <= row['size'] <= 24:
        return False
    code = original.data(address, row['size'])
    tail = code[-9:]
    return (b'\x75\x08' in code[:4] or b'\x55\x08' in code[:4] or b'\x45\x08' in code[:4] or
            b'\x4d\x08' in code[:4]) and tail[:4] == b'\x6a\x00\x6a\x00' and tail[4] == 0xe8 and \
        (address + row['size'] + struct.unpack('<i', tail[5:9])[0]) & 0xffffffff == 0x6a158c


def body_exact_at(unit, symbol, value):
    hb, hr = unit.bodies[symbol]
    ht, htr, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % value)
    if len(ht) == len(hb):
        return match.exact_match(ht, htr, hb, hr)
    # support bodies only: a compiled function whose original extent functions.jsonl splits at its catch(...)
    # funclet (the 138 local-extent pins / app-unit4b4 pattern) is compared as head + funclet row
    end = value + len(ht)
    if len(hb) > len(ht) and is_catch_funclet(end) and len(ht) + FUNCTIONS[end]['size'] == len(hb):
        ft, ftr, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % end)
        ok = match.exact_match(ht + ft, list(htr) + [r + len(ht) for r in ftr], hb, hr)
        if ok:
            SPLITS['%s at %#x' % (symbol[:90], value)] = (
                '%d-byte compiled body = %d-byte row + the %d-byte catch(...) funclet row at %#x (BOUNDS evidence)'
                % (len(hb), len(ht), len(ft), end))
        return ok
    return False


def relocs(unit, address, name):
    body, _ = unit.bodies[name]
    target = original.data(address, len(body))   # the original bytes (a split body continues into its funclet)
    start, section = unit.definitions[name]
    table = unit.sections[section]
    code = unit.raw[table[4] + start:]
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', unit.raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        offset -= start
        if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
            continue
        symbol = unit.symbols[index][0]
        if kind == 20:
            value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        else:
            value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) \
                & 0xffffffff
        yield offset, symbol, value


def classify(unit, symbol, value, where, own, stack):
    """Return (description, ok)."""
    hit = original.imported(value)
    if hit is not None:
        return '%s!%s' % hit, hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol)
    if symbol in own:
        return 'own row', own[symbol] == value
    if symbol in ALIAS and ALIAS[symbol] in own:
        return 'own row %s (??_E folded onto ??_G)' % ALIAS[symbol][:40], own[ALIAS[symbol]] == value
    if symbol in ACCESS_EXTERNAL:
        return 'external (evidence name %s)' % ACCESS_EXTERNAL[symbol][1], ACCESS_EXTERNAL[symbol][0] == value
    if symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
        pos, at = unit.definitions[symbol]
        lit = unit.raw[unit.sections[at][4] + pos:unit.sections[at][4] + unit.sections[at][3]]
        lit = lit.split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
        return 'literal %r' % lit[:-1].decode('latin-1'), original.data(value, len(lit)) == lit
    if symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
        rtti = original.string(value + 8)
        return 'RTTI %s' % rtti, norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2])
    if symbol.startswith('??_7'):
        try:
            rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
        except Exception:
            return 'vtable without RTTI', False
        cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
        return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at), norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls)
    if symbol in EXTERNAL:
        return ('external' + (' (evidence name)' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) else ''),
                EXTERNAL[symbol] == value)
    if symbol in unit.bodies and any(lo <= value < hi for lo, hi in TEXT):
        ok, why = support(unit, symbol, value, stack)
        tag = 'support body exact at the bound address (not counted here)'
        if '%08x' % value in elsewhere:
            tag = 'body exact at the bound address; row counted by %s' % ', '.join(sorted(set(elsewhere['%08x' % value])))
        return (tag if ok else 'support body: ' + why), ok
    if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol):
        return 'external (evidence name)', True
    other = [u for u in U.values() if u is not unit and symbol in u.bodies]
    if other and any(lo <= value < hi for lo, hi in TEXT):
        ok, why = support(other[0], symbol, value, stack)
        return ('support body of the %s unit exact at the bound address' % other[0].key if ok else
                'support body (%s unit): %s' % (other[0].key, why)), ok
    if symbol not in unit.bodies and any(lo <= value < hi for lo, hi in DATA_SECTIONS):
        # static data (defined here or declared only: class-name statics, local statics, EH / RTTI records): one
        # address per symbol across every reference; named statics are asserted by content below
        LOCAL_STATIC.setdefault(symbol, value)
        return 'static data (one address per symbol)', True
    return None, False


def check(unit, address, name, own, stack):
    """Verify every relocation of `name` placed at `address`; return (targets, failures, local_eh)."""
    targets, failures, local_eh = {}, [], []
    for offset, symbol, value in relocs(unit, address, name):
        where = '%08x+%#x' % (address, offset)
        if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            local_eh.append(symbol)
            continue
        how, ok = classify(unit, symbol, value, where, own, stack)
        if how is None:
            failures.append('%s %s -> %#x: unbound%s' % (where, symbol[:90], value,
                                                          (' (' + names[value][:60] + ')') if value in names else ''))
            continue
        if not ok:
            failures.append('%s %s -> %#x: %s' % (where, symbol[:90], value, how))
            continue
        if not bind(symbol, value, where):
            failures.append('%s %s -> %#x: second address for one symbol' % (where, symbol[:90], value))
            continue
        targets[symbol] = '%#x (%s)' % (value, how)
    return targets, failures, sorted(set(local_eh))


def support(unit, symbol, value, stack):
    key = (unit.key, symbol, value)
    if key in SUPPORT:
        return SUPPORT[key]
    if key in stack:
        return True, 'recursive'
    if not body_exact_at(unit, symbol, value):
        SUPPORT[key] = (False, 'the body compiled here is not exact at %#x' % value)
        return SUPPORT[key]
    targets, failures, _ = check(unit, value, symbol, OWN_CURRENT, stack | {key})
    SUPPORT[key] = (not failures, '; '.join(failures)[:300] if failures else 'ok')
    SUPPORT_TARGETS['%s %s' % (unit.key, symbol)] = {'address': '%#x' % value, 'verified_targets': targets,
                                                    'failures': failures}
    return SUPPORT[key]

def compiled_vtables(unit):
    out = {}
    for name, (start, sec) in unit.definitions.items():
        if not name.startswith('??_7'):
            continue
        table = unit.sections[sec]
        end = min([x for x in unit.starts.get(sec + 1, ()) if x > start] + [table[3]])
        slots = {}
        for i in range(table[7]):

            if start <= offset < end:
                slots[(offset - start) // 4] = unit.symbols[index][0]
        out[name] = slots
    return out

def target_of(address):
    body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
    return body, refs


def try_fold(which, symbol, value):
    """A compiler helper / COMDAT body bound outside the counted rows: the body compiled here must be exact there."""
    if symbol not in BODIES[which] or value not in FUNCTIONS:
        return False
    body, refs = BODIES[which][symbol]
    target, target_refs = target_of(value)
    if not match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs):
        return False
    FOLDED.setdefault(symbol, (value, which))
    return FOLDED[symbol][0] == value


def local_static(symbol, value):
    for pattern, address in LOCAL_STATIC:
        if re.match(pattern, symbol):
            prev = LOCAL_STATIC_AT.setdefault(symbol, address)
            return prev == value == address
    return False


def resolve(rows, which):
    funcs = BODIES[which]
    out = []
    for address, name in rows:
        hits = [name] if name in funcs else [n for n in funcs if n.startswith(name) and not nb.LOCAL_EH.match(n)]
        assert len(hits) == 1 or DISCOVER, ('%08x' % address, name, hits[:4])
        if len(hits) == 1:
            out.append((address, hits[0]))
    return out


def verify(which, rows, own, strict=True, record=True):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = BODIES[which]
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict or DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
                assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'string %r' % literal[:-1].decode('latin-1')
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert rtti.replace('3QBDB', '3PBDB') == ('.?AV' + cls).replace('3QBDB', '3PBDB'), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol.startswith('??_R0'):
                # type descriptor (typeid / __RTDynamicCast operand): its name string at +8 is the mangled type name
                assert original.string(value + 8) == '.' + symbol[5:-2] and symbol.endswith('@8'), (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'RTTI type descriptor %s' % original.string(value + 8)
            elif symbol.startswith('__TI') and symbol in EXTERNAL:

                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
                USED_EXTERNAL.add(symbol)

def counted_elsewhere():
    """Rows other receipts count: their top-level exact_function_rows (or exact_addresses / exact_unique_addresses),
    else the rows marked exact in their counted method lists (keys `methods` or `*_methods`, never `pending_*`)."""
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            rows = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            for key, value in data.items():
                if (key == 'methods' or key.endswith('_methods')) and not key.startswith('pending'):
                    walk(value)
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = list(rows)
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault('%08x' % int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

            if isinstance(data.get(key), (list, dict)):
                rows = list(data[key])

        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])

def resolve(obj, rows):

    out = []
    for address, key in rows:
        hits = [n for n in funcs if n == key] or [n for n in funcs if n.startswith(key) and not nb.LOCAL_EH.match(n)]
        if DISCOVER and len(hits) != 1:
            print('UNRESOLVED', '%08x' % address, key[:120], [h[:120] for h in hits][:5])
            continue
        assert len(hits) == 1, ('%08x' % address, key, hits[:5])
        out.append((address, hits[0]))

def verify(build_key, rows, own, strict=True, record=True):
    raw = Path(OBJ[build_key]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    out = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = len(body) == len(target) and bool(match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs))
        row = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target),
               'exact': exact, 'build': build_key}
        out.append(row)
        if not exact:
            assert not strict or DISCOVER, (build_key, row['address'], name[:80], len(body), len(target))
            continue
        row.update({'verified_targets': {}, 'local_eh': []})
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            where = '%08x+%#x' % (address, offset)
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                row['local_eh'].append(symbol)
                continue
            how = None
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol in ALIAS:
                assert symbol not in bodies and own[ALIAS[symbol]] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'own row %s (alias: no vector deleting destructor is emitted)' % ALIAS[symbol]
            elif symbol in ACCESS_EXTERNAL:
                expect, evidence = ACCESS_EXTERNAL[symbol]
                assert expect == value and names.get(value) == evidence, (where, symbol, hex(value), names.get(value))
                how = 'external (evidence name %s; access letter differs)' % evidence
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                lit = string_literal(raw, sections, definitions, symbol)
                assert original.data(value, len(lit)) == lit, (where, symbol, hex(value), lit)
                how = 'string literal %r' % lit[:-1].decode('latin-1')
            elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
                rtti = original.string(value + 8)
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'RTTI %s' % rtti
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol in CLASS_NAMES:
                assert original.string(value) == CLASS_NAMES[symbol], (where, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'class-name array %r' % CLASS_NAMES[symbol]
            elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol):
                    how = 'external (evidence name)'
                else:
                    if symbol not in IDENTITY:
                        assert DISCOVER, (where, symbol, names.get(value, '')[:100])
                        UNBOUND.append('    IDENTITY needed %r %#x # %s' % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:70]))
                        continue
                    how = 'external (identity: %s)' % IDENTITY[symbol]
            elif symbol in LOCAL_STATIC_AT:
                assert LOCAL_STATIC_AT[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(LOCAL_STATIC_AT[symbol]))
                assert any(lo <= value < hi for lo, hi in DATA_SECTIONS), (where, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'unit / function static (one address per symbol)'
            elif '%08x' % value in elsewhere and symbol in bodies:
                hb, hr = bodies[symbol]
                ht, htr = target_of(value)
                assert match.exact_match(ht, htr, hb, hr), ('counted-elsewhere body not exact', symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'row counted by %s (compiled body exact at the bound address)' % ', '.join(
                    sorted(set(elsewhere['%08x' % value])))
            elif symbol in bodies and value in FUNCTIONS:
                hb, hr = bodies[symbol]
                ht, htr = target_of(value)
                if len(hb) == len(ht) and match.exact_match(ht, htr, hb, hr):
                    HELPERS.setdefault(symbol, '%#x' % value)
                    how = 'helper body exact at the bound address (not counted here)'
            if how is None and names.get(value) and norm(names[value]) == norm(symbol):
                how = 'external (evidence name)'
            if how is None:
                UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s at %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:70], where))
                continue
            if record:
                bind(symbol, value, where)
            row['verified_targets'][symbol] = '%#x (%s)' % (value, how)

def compiled_vtables(obj_path, prefix):
    raw = Path(obj_path).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    out = {}
    for symbol in sorted(s for s in definitions if s.startswith(prefix)):
        start, sec = definitions[symbol]
        table = sections[sec]
        relocs = sorted(struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * k) for k in range(table[7]))
        slots = {(off - start) // 4: symbols[idx][0] for off, idx, kind in relocs
                 if kind == 6 and off >= start and (off - start) % 4 == 0}
        col = [symbols[idx][0] for off, idx, kind in relocs if kind == 6 and off == start - 4]
        assert len(col) == 1 and col[0].startswith('??_R4'), (symbol, col)
        cstart, csec = definitions[col[0]]
        sub_offset = struct.unpack_from('<I', raw, sections[csec][4] + cstart + 4)[0]
        out[symbol] = (sub_offset, slots)
    return out

def verify(which, rows, own, strict=True, record=True):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = BODIES[which]
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict or DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)

            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:

                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
                assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'string %r' % literal[:-1].decode('latin-1')
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol.startswith('??_R0'):

                assert original.string(value + 8) == '.' + symbol[5:-2] and symbol.endswith('@8'), (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'RTTI type descriptor %s' % original.string(value + 8)
            elif symbol in own:

            if record:

            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})

# ---- vtable from the object built with the current headers, slot by slot ---------------------------------------------
def compiled_vtable(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[section]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return [slots[i] for i in range(len(slots))]


def check_vtable(obj, symbol, address):
    out, bad = [], []
    for i, slot in enumerate(compiled_vtable(obj, symbol)):
        value = d(address + 4 * i)
        if slot.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + slot[4:] in own:
            ok, how = own['??_G' + slot[4:]] == value, 'bound (??_G row)'
        elif slot in own:
            ok, how = own[slot] == value, 'bound'
        else:
            ok, how = False, 'unbound'
        out.append({'slot': i, 'symbol': slot, 'original': '%08x' % value, 'ok': ok, 'how': how})
        if not ok:
            bad.append((i, slot, hex(value), how))
    assert not bad or DISCOVER, (symbol, bad)
    return out

def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            rows = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk(data.get('methods', []))
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = list(rows)
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault('%08x' % int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

    out = {}

            if isinstance(data.get(key), (list, dict)):
                rows = list(data[key])
                break
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])

        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        row = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target),
               'exact': bool(exact), 'build': build, 'verified_targets': {}, 'local_eh': []}
        out.append(row)
        if not exact:
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            where = '%08x+%#x' % (address, offset)

def target_of(address):
    body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
    return body, refs


def try_fold(which, symbol, value):
    """A compiler helper / COMDAT body bound outside the counted rows: the body compiled here must be exact there."""
    if symbol not in BODIES[which] or value not in FUNCTIONS:
        return False
    body, refs = BODIES[which][symbol]
    target, target_refs = target_of(value)
    if not match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs):
        return False
    FOLDED.setdefault(symbol, (value, which))
    return FOLDED[symbol][0] == value


def local_static(symbol, value):
    for pattern, address in LOCAL_STATIC:
        if re.match(pattern, symbol):
            prev = LOCAL_STATIC_AT.setdefault(symbol, address)
            return prev == value == address
    return False


def resolve(rows, which):
    funcs = BODIES[which]
    for row in rows:
        assert row[1] in funcs or DISCOVER, ('%08x' % row[0], row[1], [n for n in funcs if n[:20] == row[1][:20]])
    return [row[:2] for row in rows if row[1] in funcs]


def verify(which, rows, own, strict=True, record=True):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = BODIES[which]
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict or DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None and symbol in ICF_IMPORT:
                assert hit == ICF_IMPORT[symbol], (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s (identical-code folded import thunk)' % hit
                USED_ICF_IMPORT.add(symbol)
            elif hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
                assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'string %r' % literal[:-1].decode('latin-1')
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)

                assert own['??_G' + symbol[4:]] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'own row (??_E folded with the ??_G body)'
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'

                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
                USED_EXTERNAL.add(symbol)
            elif local_static(symbol, value):

            elif try_fold(which, symbol, value):

def bases(vtable):
    hierarchy = d(d(vtable - 4) + 16)
    out = {}
    for i in range(d(hierarchy + 8)):
        bcd = d(d(hierarchy + 12) + 4 * i)
        out.setdefault(original.string(d(bcd) + 8), struct.unpack('<i', original.data(bcd + 8, 4))[0])
    return out

# ---- vtables from the object built with the current headers, slot by slot ---------------------------------------------
def compiled_vtable(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[section]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return [slots[i] for i in range(len(slots))]


def check_vtable(obj, symbol, address, known=None):
    known = known or {}
    out, bad = [], []
    for i, slot in enumerate(compiled_vtable(obj, symbol)):
        value = d(address + 4 * i)
        if slot.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + slot[4:] in own:
            ok, how = own['??_G' + slot[4:]] == value, 'bound (??_G row)'
        elif slot in own:
            ok, how = own[slot] == value, 'bound'
        elif slot in EXTERNAL:
            ok, how = EXTERNAL[slot] == value, 'external'
            USED_EXTERNAL.add(slot)
        elif slot in pending_own:
            ok, how = pending_own[slot] == value, 'bound (pending-build-only row)'
        elif slot in FOLDED:
            ok, how = FOLDED[slot][0] == value, 'helper body'
        else:
            ok, how = False, 'unbound'
        if not ok and i in known:
            how = 'known mismatch: ' + known[i]
            ok = None
        out.append({'slot': i, 'symbol': slot, 'original': hex(value), 'ok': ok, 'how': how})
        if ok is False:
            bad.append((i, slot, hex(value), how))
    assert not bad or DISCOVER, (symbol, bad)
    if DISCOVER and bad:
        print('VTABLE', symbol[:60], bad)
    return out

# ---- counting rules ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            rows = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk(data.get('methods', []))
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = list(rows)
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault('%08x' % int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

def pinned_profile(src):
    """The source's own `native-flags` line (if any): /I directories go first; every other flag must already be in the
    document-swap base flags (checked) or be /fp:fast (appended)."""
    m = re.search(r'^// native-flags: (.*)$', src.read_text(), re.M)
    first, extra = [], []
    if not m:
        return first, extra
    base = set(nb.flags())
    for f in m.group(1).split():
        if f.startswith('/I'):
            first.append('/I' + f[2:].replace('{headers}', str(HEADER_DIR)))
        elif f not in base:
            assert f == '/fp:fast', (src.name, f)
            extra.append(f)
    return first, extra


def build(name, src):
    first, extra = pinned_profile(src)
    obj = OUT / ('NativeU580_' + name + '.obj')
    flags = nb.flags()
    i = next(k for k, x in enumerate(flags) if x.replace('\\', '/').endswith('rebuild/2008-06/native-headers'))
    flags = flags[:i] + first + flags[i:] + extra + ['/Fo' + str(obj), str(src)]
    code, log = rebuild.run(rebuild.toolchain(21022), 'cl', flags, OUT)
    assert code == 0, (name, log[-4000:])
    return name, obj, flags

def vtable_of(cls):
    """The one complete-object vtable (in .rdata, offset 0) whose RTTI type descriptor names `.?AV<cls>@`."""
    name = ('.?AV' + cls + '@\0').encode()
    found = []
    for m in re.finditer(re.escape(name), IMG):
        td = BASE + m.start() - 8
        for m2 in re.finditer(re.escape(struct.pack('<I', td)), IMG):
            col = BASE + m2.start() - 12
            if not RDATA_LO <= col < RDATA_HI or d(col) != 0 or d(col + 4) != 0:
                continue
            for m3 in re.finditer(re.escape(struct.pack('<I', col)), IMG):
                v = BASE + m3.start() + 4
                if RDATA_LO <= v < RDATA_HI:
                    found.append(v)
    assert len(found) == 1, (cls, [hex(x) for x in found])
    assert original.vtable_class(found[0]) == ('.?AV' + cls + '@', 0)
    return found[0]


REFS = {}   # target -> set of rel32 call/jmp sites in .text
