def classify(symbol, value, where):
    hit = original.imported(value)
    if hit is not None:
        assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
        return '%s!%s' % hit
    if symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
        pos, at = definitions[symbol]
        literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
        assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
    if symbol.startswith('__real@') and len(symbol) in (15, 23):
        bits = bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1]
        assert original.data(value, len(bits)) == bits, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
    if symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
        rtti = original.string(value + 8)
        assert rtti == '.' + symbol[5:-2], (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'RTTI %s' % rtti
    if symbol.startswith('??_7'):
        rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
        cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
        assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
        return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
    if symbol in own:
        assert own[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
        return 'own row'
    if symbol.startswith('??_E') and ('??_G' + symbol[4:]) in own:
        assert own['??_G' + symbol[4:]] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'own row (??_E and ??_G folded)'
    if symbol in DATA_BYTES:
        at, data = DATA_BYTES[symbol]
        assert at == value and original.data(value, len(data)) == data, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'data %r' % data
    if symbol in DATA:
        assert DATA[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(DATA[symbol]))
        return 'static (constructed by its initializer; see data_statics)'
    if symbol in EXTERNAL:
        assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
        tag = ' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else ''
        if value in OTHERS:
            tag += ' (counted by %s)' % ', '.join(OTHERS[value])
        return 'external' + tag
    body_symbol = symbol
    if symbol.startswith('??_E') and symbol not in bodies and ('??_G' + symbol[4:]) in bodies:
        body_symbol = '??_G' + symbol[4:]     # the vector deleting destructor slot holds the ??_G body
    if body_symbol in bodies and not nb.LOCAL_EH.match(body_symbol):
        symbol = body_symbol
        body, refs = bodies[symbol]
        try:
            target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % value)
        except Exception:
            return None
        if match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs):
            if symbol not in support:
                support[symbol] = value
                pending.append((value, symbol))
            assert support[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'support body exact at the bound address'
            if value in OTHERS:
                how += ' (counted by %s)' % ', '.join(OTHERS[value])
            return how
        return None
    if symbol.startswith('??_E') and ('??_G' + symbol[4:]) in support:
        assert support['??_G' + symbol[4:]] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
        return 'support body (??_E and ??_G folded)'
    if LOCAL_STATIC.match(symbol) or symbol.startswith(('?flag@', '?foo@', '?root@', '?n@?1???$doDeclare@', '?type@?1???$singleton@')):
        return 'local static'
    return None


def verify(address, name):
    body, refs = bodies[name]
    target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
    if not match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs):
        return None
    start, section = definitions[name]
    table = sections[section]
    code = raw[table[4] + start:]
    verified, local = {}, set()
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        offset -= start
        if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
            continue
        symbol = symbols[index][0]
        assert kind in (6, 20), (name, symbol, kind)
        if kind == 20:
            value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        else:
            value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            local.add(symbol)
            continue
        how = classify(symbol, value, name)
        if how is None:
            UNBOUND.append('    %r: %#x,   # in %s' % (symbol, value, name[:100]))
            continue
        prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
        if prev[0] != value:
            UNBOUND.append('inconsistent %s: %s (%s) vs %s (%s)' % (symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name))
        verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
    return {'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)}

def try_fold(which, symbol, value):
    """A compiler helper / COMDAT body bound outside the counted rows: the body compiled here must be exact there."""
    if symbol not in BODIES[which] or value not in FUNCTIONS:
        return False
    body, refs = BODIES[which][symbol]
    target, target_refs = target_of(value)
    if not match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs):

    FOLDED.setdefault(symbol, (value, which))

    return False

def verify(which, rows, own, strict=True, record=True):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = BODIES[which]
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict or DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
                assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'string %r' % literal[:-1].decode('latin-1')
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol in OWN_DATA_SYMBOLS and symbol in definitions:
                # data defined in this unit (char sPartDragTool[] / sGroupDragTool[]): compare the bytes
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                if sections[at][4] == 0:
                    UNBOUND.append('    %r: %#x,   # own data without raw bytes in %s' % (symbol, value, name[:60]))
                    continue
                data = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + pos + OWN_DATA_SYMBOLS[symbol]]
                assert original.data(value, len(data)) == data, (name, symbol, hex(value), data)
                prev = OWN_DATA.setdefault(symbol, value)
                assert prev == value, (symbol, hex(prev), hex(value))
                how = 'own data %r' % data.rstrip(b'\0').decode('latin-1')
            elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
                USED_EXTERNAL.add(symbol)
            elif local_static(symbol, value):
                how = 'local static'
            elif try_fold(which, symbol, value):
                how = 'helper / COMDAT body, compared exact at the bound address'
            else:
                UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
                continue
            if record:
                prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
                assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

# ---- structure: allocation sizes before the constructor calls, RTTI bases --------------------------------------------
def new_before(call_site, ctor, size):
    window = original.data(call_site - 0x60, 0x65)
    assert window[-5] == 0xe8 and call_site + 5 + struct.unpack_from('<i', window, 0x61)[0] == ctor, hex(call_site)
    push = (b'\x6a' + bytes([size])) if size < 0x80 else (b'\x68' + struct.pack('<I', size))
    # the last `push size` before the constructor call, then the first `call operator new` after it (the operand
    # loads in between are scheduled by the compiler: PartDragTool() 00665f8f pushes 0x70 before the hitWorld copy)
    at = window.rindex(push)
    calls = [i for i in range(at + len(push), len(window) - 9)
             if window[i] == 0xe8 and call_site - 0x60 + i + 5 + struct.unpack_from('<i', window, i + 1)[0] == 0x6a0920]
    assert calls, hex(call_site)
    return '%08x: new(%#x) before %08x' % (call_site, size, ctor)

def compiled_vtable(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[section]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return [slots[i] for i in range(len(slots))]


def check_vtable(obj, symbol, address, base):
    out, bad = [], []
    for i, slot in enumerate(compiled_vtable(obj, symbol)):
        value = d(address + 4 * i)
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if slot.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + slot[4:] in slot_names:
            ok, how = slot_names['??_G' + slot[4:]] == value, 'bound (??_G row)'
        elif slot in slot_names:
            ok, how = slot_names[slot] == value, 'bound' + (' (pending-build-only row)' if slot in pending_slot else '')
        elif hit is not None:
            ok, how = hit[1] == nb.plain(slot), 'import thunk %s!%s' % hit
        elif names.get(value, '') == slot:
            ok, how = True, 'evidence name at the slot target'
        elif ('@MouseCommand@RBX@@' in slot or '@IRenderable@RBX@@' in slot) and not slot.startswith('??_'):
            ok, how = d(BASE_VTABLES[base][0] + 4 * i) == value, 'inherited: same slot of the MouseCommand %s vtable' % base
        else:
            ok, how = False, 'unbound'
        out.append({'slot': i, 'symbol': slot, 'original': '%08x' % value, 'ok': ok, 'how': how})
        if not ok:
            bad.append((i, slot, hex(value), how, names.get(value, '')[:80]))
    assert not bad or DISCOVER, (symbol, bad)
    if bad:
        print('VTABLE', symbol[:60], bad)
    return out

# ---- counting rules ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            rows = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk(data.get('methods', []))
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = list(rows)
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault('%08x' % int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

def verify(which, rows, own):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = BODIES[which]
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        assert name in bodies or DISCOVER, (name, [n for n in bodies if n[:16] == name[:16]])
        if name not in bodies:
            continue
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target),
                 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        assert len(body) == len(target) == FUNCS[address]['size'], (name, len(body), len(target))
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
                assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif local_static(symbol, value):
                how = 'function-local static'
            else:
                UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))

            prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
            assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def text_dir32_refs(value, span):
    """Code addresses whose instructions carry a DIR32 operand inside [value, value + span)."""
    pe = original.pe
    base = pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.ImageBase
    hits = []
    for sec in pe.sections:
        if not sec.Name.startswith(b'.text'):
            continue
        data = sec.get_data()
        va0 = base + sec.VirtualAddress
        for v in range(value, value + span, 4):
            for m in re.finditer(re.escape(struct.pack('<I', v)), data):
                hits.append(va0 + m.start())
    return hits


def section_name(value):
    pe = original.pe
    rva = value - pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.ImageBase
    for sec in pe.sections:
        if sec.VirtualAddress <= rva < sec.VirtualAddress + max(sec.Misc_VirtualSize, sec.SizeOfRawData):
            return sec.Name.rstrip(b'\0').decode()
    return None

def try_fold(which, symbol, value):
    """A COMDAT / STL helper body bound outside the counted rows: the body compiled here must be exact there."""

        return False
    body, refs = BODIES[which][symbol]
    target, target_refs = target_of(value)
    if not match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs):
        return False
    FOLDED.setdefault(symbol, (value, which))
    return FOLDED[symbol][0] == value


def verify(which, rows, own):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = BODIES[which]
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        assert name in bodies or DISCOVER, (name, [n for n in bodies if n[:16] == name[:16]])
        if name not in bodies:
            continue
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target),
                 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
                USED_EXTERNAL.add(symbol)
            elif try_fold(which, symbol, value):
                how = 'helper / COMDAT body, compared exact at the bound address'
            else:
                UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
                continue
            prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
            assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

# ---- structure: allocation size before the constructor call, RTTI bases ----------------------------------------------
def new_before(call_site, ctor, size):
    window = original.data(call_site - 0x40, 0x45)
    assert window[-5] == 0xe8 and call_site + 5 + struct.unpack_from('<i', window, 0x41)[0] == ctor, hex(call_site)
    push = (b'\x6a' + bytes([size])) if size < 0x80 else (b'\x68' + struct.pack('<I', size))
    at = window.rindex(push)
    calls = [i for i in range(at + len(push), len(window) - 9)
             if window[i] == 0xe8 and call_site - 0x40 + i + 5 + struct.unpack_from('<i', window, i + 1)[0] == 0x6a0920]
    assert calls, hex(call_site)
    return '%08x: new(%#x) before %08x' % (call_site, size, ctor)

# ---- vtable from the object built with the current header, slot by slot ----------------------------------------------
def compiled_vtable(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[section]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return [slots[i] for i in range(len(slots))]


def check_vtable(obj, symbol, address):
    out, bad = [], []
    slot_names = dict(own)
    for s, (v, _) in FOLDED.items():
        slot_names.setdefault(s, v)
    for i, slot in enumerate(compiled_vtable(obj, symbol)):
        value = d(address + 4 * i)
        if slot.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + slot[4:] in slot_names:
            ok, how = slot_names['??_G' + slot[4:]] == value, 'bound (??_G row)'
        elif slot in slot_names:
            ok, how = slot_names[slot] == value, 'bound'
        elif slot in VTABLE_NOT_BUILT:
            ok, how = VTABLE_NOT_BUILT[slot] == value, 'not built here; slot value checked'
        elif slot in BODIES['tree'] and value in FUNCTIONS:
            target, target_refs = target_of(value)
            ok, how = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, *BODIES['tree'][slot]), 'inline body compared exact'
        else:
            ok, how = False, 'unbound'
        out.append({'slot': i, 'symbol': slot, 'original': H(value), 'ok': ok, 'how': how})
        if not ok:
            bad.append((i, slot, hex(value), how))
    assert not bad or DISCOVER, (symbol, bad)
    assert len(out) == 7, len(out)
    return out

def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        found = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            found = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            found = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            found = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        found.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk(data.get('methods', []))
        if isinstance(found, dict):
            found = list(found)
        for r in found:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault(int(m.group(1), 16), set()).add(Path(path).name)
    return out

    obj = OUT / (name + '.obj')

    i = next(k for k, f in enumerate(flags) if f.startswith('/I'))

def target_of(address):
    body, refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
    return body, refs


def try_fold(which, symbol, value):
    """A COMDAT / library helper body bound outside the counted rows: the body compiled here must be exact there."""
    if symbol not in BODIES[which] or value not in FUNCTIONS:
        return False
    body, refs = BODIES[which][symbol]
    target, target_refs = target_of(value)
    if not match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs):
        return False
    FOLDED.setdefault(symbol, (value, which))
    return FOLDED[symbol][0] == value


def verify(which, rows, own, strict=True):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = BODIES[which]
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        assert name in bodies or DISCOVER, (name, [n for n in bodies if n[:16] == name[:16]])
        if name not in bodies:
            continue
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address if strict else H(address), 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body),
                 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict or DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
                assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol in LOCAL_STATIC:
                assert LOCAL_STATIC[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(LOCAL_STATIC[symbol]))
                how = 'function-local static'
            elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
                USED_EXTERNAL.add(symbol)
            elif try_fold(which, symbol, value):
                how = 'helper / COMDAT body, compared exact at the bound address'
            else:
                UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
                continue
            prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
            assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

# ---- structure: allocation size before the constructor call, RTTI bases ----------------------------------------------
def new_before(call_site, ctor, size):
    window = original.data(call_site - 0x40, 0x45)
    assert window[-5] == 0xe8 and call_site + 5 + struct.unpack_from('<i', window, 0x41)[0] == ctor, hex(call_site)
    push = (b'\x6a' + bytes([size])) if size < 0x80 else (b'\x68' + struct.pack('<I', size))
    at = window.rindex(push)
    calls = [i for i in range(at + len(push), len(window) - 9)
             if window[i] == 0xe8 and call_site - 0x40 + i + 5 + struct.unpack_from('<i', window, i + 1)[0] == 0x6a0920]
    assert calls, hex(call_site)
    return '%08x: new(%#x) before %08x' % (call_site, size, ctor)


def call_site(caller, callee):
    for ins in CS.disasm(original.data(caller, FUNCS[caller]['size']), caller):
        if ins.mnemonic == 'call' and ins.op_str == hex(callee):
            return ins.address
    raise AssertionError((hex(caller), hex(callee)))

def bases(vtable):
    hierarchy = d(d(vtable - 4) + 16)
    out = {}
    for i in range(d(hierarchy + 8)):
        bcd = d(d(hierarchy + 12) + 4 * i)
        out.setdefault(original.string(d(bcd) + 8), struct.unpack('<i', original.data(bcd + 8, 4))[0])
    return out

# ---- vtable from the object built with the current header, slot by slot ----------------------------------------------
def compiled_vtable(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[section]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return [slots[i] for i in range(len(slots))]


def check_vtable(obj, symbol, address, which):
    out, bad = [], []
    slot_names = dict(own)
    for s, (v, _) in FOLDED.items():
        slot_names.setdefault(s, v)
    for i, slot in enumerate(compiled_vtable(obj, symbol)):
        value = d(address + 4 * i)
        if slot.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + slot[4:] in slot_names:
            ok, how = slot_names['??_G' + slot[4:]] == value, 'bound (??_G row)'
        elif slot in slot_names:
            ok, how = slot_names[slot] == value, 'bound'
        elif slot in VTABLE_NOT_BUILT:
            ok, how = VTABLE_NOT_BUILT[slot] == value, 'not built here; slot value checked'
        elif slot in BODIES[which] and value in FUNCTIONS:
            target, target_refs = target_of(value)
            ok, how = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, *BODIES[which][slot]), 'inline body compared exact'
        else:
            ok, how = False, 'unbound'
        out.append({'slot': i, 'symbol': slot, 'original': H(value), 'ok': ok, 'how': how})
        if not ok:
            bad.append((i, slot, hex(value), how))
    assert not bad or DISCOVER, (symbol, bad)
    assert len(out) == 7, len(out)
    return out

# ---- counting rules --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        found = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            found = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            found = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            found = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        found.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk(data.get('methods', []))
        if isinstance(found, dict):

def try_fold(symbol, value):
    """Bind a call to a body the linker folded elsewhere (or a compiler-generated helper outside the block): the body
    compiled here must equal the target exactly."""
    if symbol not in BODIES or value not in FUNCTIONS:
        return False
    body, refs, _ = BODIES[symbol]
    target, target_refs = target_of(value)
    if not match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs):
        return False
    FOLDED.setdefault(symbol, value)
    return FOLDED[symbol] == value


def local_static(symbol, value):
    for pattern, address in LOCAL_STATIC:
        if re.match(pattern, symbol):
            prev = LOCAL_STATIC_AT.setdefault(symbol, address)
            return prev == value == address
    return False

    return [(a, n) for a, n in rows if n in funcs]


def verify(which, rows, own, strict=True, record=True):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict or DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        start, section = definitions[name]
        table = sections[section]
        code = raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            hit = original.imported(value)
            if hit is not None:
                assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
                how = '%s!%s' % hit
            elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
                assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
            elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
                pos, at = definitions[symbol]
                literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
                assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'string %r' % literal[:-1].decode('latin-1')
            elif symbol.startswith('__TI'):
                cls = '.?AV' + symbol[symbol.index('?AV') + 3:]
                assert throw_info_type(value) == cls, (name, symbol, hex(value), throw_info_type(value))
                THROW_INFO[symbol] = (value, cls)
                how = 'throw info %s' % cls
            elif symbol.startswith('??_R0?AV'):
                cls = symbol[5:symbol.rindex('@8')]
                assert original.string(value + 8) == '.' + cls, (name, symbol, hex(value), original.string(value + 8))
                how = 'type descriptor %s' % original.string(value + 8)
            elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
                rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
                cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
                assert rtti == '.?AV' + cls, (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
                how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
            elif symbol in own:
                assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
                how = 'own row'
            elif symbol.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + symbol[4:] in own:
                # the adjustor thunk 00685840 jumps to the scalar deleting destructor row (vector form not emitted)
                assert own['??_G' + symbol[4:]] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
                how = 'own ??_G row (deleting destructor)'
            elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
                assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
                how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if names.get(value, '') == symbol else '')
            elif local_static(symbol, value):
                how = 'local static'
            elif try_fold(symbol, value):
                how = 'folded / helper body, compared exact'
            else:
                UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
                continue
            if record:
                prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
                assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def new_before(call_site, ctor, size):
    window = original.data(call_site - 0x60, 0x65)
    assert window[-5] == 0xe8 and call_site + 5 + struct.unpack_from('<i', window, 0x61)[0] == ctor, hex(call_site)
    push = (b'\x6a' + bytes([size])) if size < 0x80 else (b'\x68' + struct.pack('<I', size))
    at = window.rindex(push + b'\xe8')
    assert call_site - 0x60 + at + len(push) + 5 + struct.unpack_from('<i', window, at + len(push) + 1)[0] == 0x6a0920, \
        hex(call_site)

def bases(vtable):
    hierarchy = d(d(vtable - 4) + 16)
    out = {}
    for i in range(d(hierarchy + 8)):

        out.setdefault(original.string(d(bcd) + 8), struct.unpack('<i', original.data(bcd + 8, 4))[0])
    return out

def compiled_vtable(obj, symbol):
    raw = Path(obj).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[section]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return [slots[i] for i in range(len(slots))]


def check_vtable(obj, symbol, address):
    out, bad = [], []
    for i, slot in enumerate(compiled_vtable(obj, symbol)):
        value = d(address + 4 * i)
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if slot.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + slot[4:] in slot_names:
            ok, how = slot_names['??_G' + slot[4:]] == value, 'bound (??_G)'
        elif slot in slot_names:
            ok, how = slot_names[slot] == value, 'bound'
        elif hit is not None:
            ok, how = hit[1] == nb.plain(slot), 'import thunk %s!%s' % hit
        else:
            ok, how = False, 'unbound'
        out.append({'slot': i, 'symbol': slot, 'original': '%08x' % value, 'ok': ok, 'how': how})
        if not ok:
            bad.append((i, slot, hex(value), how))
    assert not bad, (symbol, bad)
    return out

# ---- counting rules ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            rows = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk(data.get('methods', []))
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = list(rows)
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault('%08x' % int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

def target_of(address):

def resolve(obj, rows):
    funcs = match.coff_functions(Path(obj).read_bytes())
    out = []
    for address, key in rows:
        hits = [x for x in funcs if x[0] == key] or [x for x in funcs if x[0].startswith(key) and not nb.LOCAL_EH.match(x[0])]
        if DISCOVER and len(hits) != 1:
            print('UNRESOLVED', '%08x' % address, key[:120], [h[0][:120] for h in hits])
            continue
        assert len(hits) == 1, ('%08x' % address, key, [h[0] for h in hits])
        out.append((address, hits[0][0]))

def bind_value(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, name, body, target, address, own, extra=None, record=True, limit=None):
    """Verify every relocation of `name` (body compared against target); returns {symbol: proof}, local EH set."""
    start, section = definitions[name]
    table = sections[section]
    code = raw[table[4] + start:]
    verified, local = {}, set()
    size = len(body) if limit is None else limit
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        offset -= start
        if not 0 <= offset < size:
            continue
        symbol = symbols[index][0]
        if kind == 20:
            value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        else:
            value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            local.add(symbol)
            continue
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
            how = '%s!%s' % hit
        elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
            pos, at = definitions[symbol]
            literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
            assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
        elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
            rtti = original.string(value + 8)
            assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            how = 'RTTI %s' % rtti
        elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
            assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
        elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
            rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
            cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
            assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            VTABLES.setdefault(symbol, value)
            how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
        elif symbol.startswith('??_8'):
            pos, at = definitions[symbol]
            blob = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + pos + 8]
            assert original.data(value, 8) == blob, (name, symbol, hex(value), blob.hex())
            how = 'vbtable bytes %s' % blob.hex()
        elif symbol in own:
            assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
            how = 'own row'
        elif symbol in FOLDED:
            assert FOLDED[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'folded'
        elif symbol in DATA:
            assert DATA[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'data'
        elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
            how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) else '')
        elif symbol in UNPROVEN:
            assert UNPROVEN[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'call target of a built, non-counted row'
        elif symbol.startswith('__TI'):
            # ThrowInfo -> CatchableTypeArray (+0xc) -> first CatchableType (+4) -> TypeDescriptor (+4) -> name
            d = lambda a: struct.unpack('<I', original.data(a, 4))[0]
            rtti = original.string(d(d(d(value + 12) + 4) + 4) + 8)
            assert rtti == '.' + symbol[symbol.index('?'):], (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            how = 'throw info, first catchable type %s' % rtti
        elif extra is not None and symbol in extra:
            assert extra[symbol] in (None, value), (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'pending-build external'
        elif symbol.startswith('??_B?1??') or symbol.startswith('?$S') or '?$TSS' in symbol or symbol.startswith('?s@?1??'):
            how = 'local static'
        else:
            UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
            continue
        if record:
            prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
            assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
        verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
    return verified, local

def verify(which, rows, own, strict=True, record=True, extra=None, limit=None):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        if limit:
            exact = len(body) == limit and match.exact_match(target[:limit], [r for r in target_refs if r < limit], body, refs)
        else:
            exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict or DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        verified, local = bind_value(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, name, body, target, address, own, extra, record, limit)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local),
                      'vtables': sorted(x for x in verified if x.startswith('??_7'))})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def vtable_slots(which, symbol):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[symbol]

def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            rows = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk(data.get('methods', []))
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = list(rows)
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault('%08x' % int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

def target_of(address):

def resolve(obj, rows):
    funcs = match.coff_functions(Path(obj).read_bytes())
    out = []
    for address, key in rows:
        hits = [x for x in funcs if x[0] == key] or [x for x in funcs if x[0].startswith(key) and not nb.LOCAL_EH.match(x[0])]

            continue

def bind_value(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, name, body, target, address, own, extra=None, record=True, limit=None):
    """Verify every relocation of `name` (body compared against target); returns {symbol: proof}, local EH set."""
    start, section = definitions[name]
    table = sections[section]
    code = raw[table[4] + start:]
    verified, local = {}, set()
    size = len(body) if limit is None else limit
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        offset -= start
        if not 0 <= offset < size:
            continue
        symbol = symbols[index][0]
        if kind == 20:
            value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        else:
            value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
        if nb.LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            local.add(symbol)
            continue
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (name, symbol, hex(value), hit)
            how = '%s!%s' % hit
        elif symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
            pos, at = definitions[symbol]
            literal = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + sections[at][3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'
            assert original.data(value, len(literal)) == literal, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'literal %r' % literal[:-1].decode()
        elif symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
            rtti = original.string(value + 8)
            assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            how = 'RTTI %s' % rtti
        elif symbol.startswith('__real@'):
            assert original.data(value, len(symbol[7:]) // 2) == bytes.fromhex(symbol[7:])[::-1], (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'constant %s' % symbol[7:]
        elif symbol.startswith('??_7'):
            rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
            cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
            assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            VTABLES.setdefault(symbol, value)
            how = 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
        elif symbol.startswith('??_8'):
            pos, at = definitions[symbol]
            blob = raw[sections[at][4] + pos:sections[at][4] + pos + 8]
            assert original.data(value, 8) == blob, (name, symbol, hex(value), blob.hex())
            how = 'vbtable bytes %s' % blob.hex()
        elif symbol in own:
            assert own[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(own[symbol]))
            how = 'own row'
        elif symbol in FOLDED:
            assert FOLDED[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'folded'
        elif symbol in DATA:
            assert DATA[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'data'
        elif symbol in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
            how = 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) else '')
        elif symbol in UNPROVEN:
            assert UNPROVEN[symbol] == value, (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'call target of a built, non-counted row'
        elif symbol.startswith('__TI'):
            # ThrowInfo -> CatchableTypeArray (+0xc) -> first CatchableType (+4) -> TypeDescriptor (+4) -> name
            d = lambda a: struct.unpack('<I', original.data(a, 4))[0]
            rtti = original.string(d(d(d(value + 12) + 4) + 4) + 8)
            assert rtti == '.' + symbol[symbol.index('?'):], (name, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            how = 'throw info, first catchable type %s' % rtti
        elif extra is not None and symbol in extra:
            assert extra[symbol] in (None, value), (name, symbol, hex(value))
            how = 'pending-build external'
        elif symbol.startswith('??_B?1??') or symbol.startswith('?$S') or '?$TSS' in symbol or symbol.startswith('?s@?1??'):
            how = 'local static'
        else:
            UNBOUND.append("    %r: %#x,   # %s in %s" % (symbol, value, names.get(value, '')[:60], name[:60]))
            continue
        if record:
            prev = binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, name))
            assert prev[0] == value, ('inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), name)
        verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
    return verified, local

def verify(which, rows, own, strict=True, record=True, extra=None, limit=None):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(raw)}
    result = []
    for address, name in rows:
        body, refs = bodies[name]
        target, target_refs = target_of(address)
        if limit:
            exact = len(body) == limit and match.exact_match(target[:limit], [r for r in target_refs if r < limit], body, refs)
        else:
            exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target), 'exact': exact}
        if not exact:
            assert not strict or DISCOVER, (name, entry['address'], len(body), len(target))
            result.append(entry)
            continue
        verified, local = bind_value(raw, sections, symbols, definitions, name, body, target, address, own, extra, record, limit)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local),
                      'vtables': sorted(x for x in verified if x.startswith('??_7'))})
        result.append(entry)
    return result

def vtable_slots(which, symbol):
    raw = Path(OBJ[which]).read_bytes()
    sections, symbols, definitions, _ = match._coff_data_index(raw)
    start, section = definitions[symbol]
    table = sections[section]
    slots = {}
    for i in range(table[7]):
        offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
        if offset >= start:
            slots[(offset - start) // 4] = symbols[index][0]
    return [slots[i] for i in range(len(slots))]

def counted_elsewhere():
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(str(ROOT / 'work/2008-06/shared-layouts/*.json')):
        if Path(path).name == RECEIPT.name:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue
        rows = []
        if 'exact_function_rows' in data:
            rows = data['exact_function_rows']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_addresses']
        elif isinstance(data.get('exact_unique_addresses'), list):
            rows = data['exact_unique_addresses']
        else:
            def walk(o):
                if isinstance(o, list):
                    for e in o:
                        walk(e)
                elif isinstance(o, dict):
                    if 'address' in o and o.get('exact') is True:
                        rows.append(o['address'])
                    else:
                        for v in o.values():
                            walk(v)
            walk(data.get('methods', []))
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = list(rows)
        for r in rows:
            r = r.get('address', '') if isinstance(r, dict) else str(r)
            m = re.match(r'(?:0x)?([0-9a-fA-F]{6,8})', r)
            if m:
                out.setdefault('%08x' % int(m.group(1), 16), []).append(Path(path).name)
    return out

        self.rows = {}        # address -> row
        self.vtables = {}

        assert prev[0] == value, (self.name, 'inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), origin)

        return self.raw[table[4] + pos:table[4] + table[3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'

            # most-derived vtables (offset 0) that would be a missing virtual: asserted. Elsewhere it can also be
            # unrelated .rdata that follows the vtable (FactoryProduct<Tool> 00841904 is followed by a boost::function

            if not own:

    def row(self, address, name):
        if address in self.rows and self.rows[address]['symbol'] == name:

        split = next(((parent, start) for parent, pieces in EXTENT_SPLITS.items() for start, size in pieces

        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target),

            else:

        return self

def norm(symbol):
    return symbol.replace('3QBDB', '3PBDB').replace('3PADA', '3PBDB')


def call_target(site):
    """Target of the direct call (or tail jump) instruction at `site` in the original."""
    assert original.data(site, 1) in (b'\xe8', b'\xe9'), hex(site)
    return (site + 5 + struct.unpack('<i', original.data(site + 1, 4))[0]) & 0xffffffff


def code(address, length):
    return original.data(address, length)

def own_vtable(rtti):
    if any(rtti.startswith('.?AV%s@RBX@@' % c) for c in OWN_CLASSES.split('|')):
        return True
    return False


class Build:
    def __init__(self, name, obj, walk_vtables):
        self.name, self.obj, self.walk = name, Path(obj), walk_vtables
        self.raw = self.obj.read_bytes()
        self.sections, self.symbols, self.definitions, self.starts = match._coff_data_index(self.raw)
        self.bodies = {n: (b, r) for n, b, r in match.coff_functions(self.raw)}
        self.binding = {}     # symbol -> (address, origin)
        self.rows = {}        # address -> row
        self.vtables = {}
        self.queue = []

    def bind(self, symbol, value, origin):
        prev = self.binding.setdefault(symbol, (value, origin))
        assert prev[0] == value, (self.name, 'inconsistent', symbol, hex(prev[0]), prev[1], hex(value), origin)

    def literal(self, symbol):
        pos, at = self.definitions[symbol]
        table = self.sections[at]
        return self.raw[table[4] + pos:table[4] + table[3]].split(b'\0')[0] + b'\0'

    def classify(self, symbol, value, where):
        if symbol in self.bodies and not LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
            self.bind(symbol, value, where)
            self.queue.append((value, symbol))
            return 'own row'
        if symbol.startswith('??_E') and '??_G' + symbol[4:] in self.bodies:
            # vector deleting destructor referenced, scalar one compiled: the same body in the original
            self.bind('??_G' + symbol[4:], value, where)
            self.queue.append((value, '??_G' + symbol[4:]))
            return 'own row (??_G)'
        hit = original.imported(value)
        if hit is not None:
            assert hit[1] == nb.plain(symbol), (where, symbol, hex(value), hit)
            return '%s!%s' % hit
        if symbol.startswith('??_C@'):
            lit = self.literal(symbol)
            assert original.data(value, len(lit)) == lit, (where, symbol, hex(value))
            return 'literal %r' % lit[:-1].decode()
        if re.match(r'^\?s[A-Z]\w*@RBX@@3QBDB$', symbol):
            lit = self.literal(symbol) if symbol in self.definitions else CLASS_NAMES[symbol[1:symbol.index('@')]] + b'\0'
            assert original.data(value, len(lit)) == lit, (where, symbol, hex(value))
            return 'class name %r' % lit[:-1].decode()
        if symbol.startswith('??_R0') and symbol.endswith('@8'):
            rtti = original.string(value + 8)
            assert norm(rtti) == norm('.' + symbol[5:-2]), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            return 'RTTI %s' % rtti
        if symbol.startswith('??_7'):
            rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
            cls = symbol[4:symbol.index('@@6B') + 2]
            assert norm(rtti) == norm('.?AV' + cls), (where, symbol, hex(value), rtti)
            if self.walk and symbol in self.definitions:
                self.bind(symbol, value, where)
                self.queue.append((value, symbol))
            return 'vtable RTTI %s offset %#x' % (rtti, at)
        if symbol.startswith('??_8'):
            return 'vbtable (bound by consistency)'
        if symbol in FOLDED:
            assert FOLDED[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
            return 'folded'
        if symbol in EXTERNAL:
            assert EXTERNAL[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(EXTERNAL[symbol]))
            return 'external' + (' (evidence name)' if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) else '')
        if symbol in DATA:
            assert DATA[symbol][0] == value and original.data(value, len(DATA[symbol][1])) == DATA[symbol][1], (where, symbol)
            return 'constant %s' % DATA[symbol][1].hex()
        if symbol in CROSS:
            assert CROSS[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value), hex(CROSS[symbol]))
            return 'own row exact in another main build of this recorder'
        if symbol in UNPROVEN:
            assert UNPROVEN[symbol] == value, (where, symbol, hex(value))
            return 'own function not attempted (bound by the original reference)'
        if norm(names.get(value, '')) == norm(symbol) and symbol not in self.definitions:
            return 'external (evidence name)'
        if (symbol.startswith('__real@') or symbol.startswith('__xmm@')) and symbol in self.definitions:
            # floating-point constants: the original operand must hold the same bytes
            pos, at = self.definitions[symbol]
            table = self.sections[at]
            size = 8 if symbol.startswith('__real@') and len(symbol) == 7 + 16 else 4 if symbol.startswith('__real@') else 16
            data = self.raw[table[4] + pos:table[4] + pos + size]
            assert original.data(value, size) == data, (where, symbol, hex(value), original.data(value, size).hex())
            return 'constant %s' % data.hex()
        if symbol in self.definitions and symbol not in self.bodies:
            # own static data (descriptor objects, local statics, guard flags): bound by consistency across rows
            return 'own static'
        return None

    def vtable(self, symbol, value):
        start, sec = self.definitions[symbol]
        table = self.sections[sec]
        end = min([x for x in self.starts[sec + 1] if x > start] + [table[3]])
        slots = {}
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', self.raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            if start <= offset < end:
                slots[(offset - start) // 4] = self.symbols[index][0]
        assert slots and max(slots) == len(slots) - 1, (symbol, sorted(slots))
        rtti, at = original.vtable_class(value)
        own = own_vtable(rtti)
        after = d(value + 4 * len(slots))
        longer = TEXT_LO <= after < TEXT_HI
        info = {'address': hex(value), 'rtti': rtti, 'offset': hex(at), 'own_class': own}
        self.vtables[symbol] = info
        if longer:
            # The dword after the compiled length is a code address in the original. For the classes' own
            # most-derived vtables (offset 0) that would be a missing virtual: asserted. Elsewhere it can also be
            # unrelated .rdata that follows the vtable (FactoryProduct<Tool> 00841904 is followed by a boost::function
            # manager table 005fdec0 / 00618cd0): recorded only.
            assert not (own and at == 0 and any(rtti == '.?AV%s@RBX@@' % c for c in OWN_CLASSES.split('|'))), \
                (symbol, hex(value), 'original vtable longer', hex(after))
            info['next_dword_is_code'] = 'slot %d position holds %s in the original' % (len(slots), hex(after))
            if not own:
                info['not_walked'] = 'shared template vtable; length not proven'
                return
        checked = {}
        for slot, sym in sorted(slots.items()):
            orig = d(value + 4 * slot)
            where = '%s slot %d' % (symbol, slot)
            if sym in self.bodies or sym.startswith('??_7') or sym.startswith('??_R'):
                how = self.classify(sym, orig, where)
                if how is None:
                    UNBOUND.append('%s: vtable %s slot %d %s -> %s' % (self.name, symbol, slot, sym, hex(orig)))
                    continue
                self.bind(sym, orig, where)
            else:
                # Inherited external virtual: verified after all builds (evidence name, EXTERNAL map, or the same
                # address at every other place the symbol occurs).
                SLOTS.append((self.name, own, sym, orig, where))
                how = 'external slot'
            checked[slot] = '%s = %s (%s)' % (sym, hex(orig), how)
        info['slots'] = checked

    def row(self, address, name):
        if address in self.rows and self.rows[address]['symbol'] == name:
            return
        body, refs = self.bodies[name]
        split = next(((parent, start) for parent, pieces in EXTENT_SPLITS.items() for start, size in pieces
                      if start == address and size == len(body)), None)
        if split:
            # One evidence extent covers several compiled functions (bounds): compare the piece of the parent extent.
            parent, start = split
            whole, whole_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % parent)
            off = start - parent
            target = whole[off:off + len(body)]
            target_refs = [x - off for x in whole_refs if off <= x < off + len(body)]
        else:
            try:
                target, target_refs, _ = match.target('2008-06', '%08x' % address)
            except SystemExit as error:
                # the original evidence has no function start here (extent covers it): recorded, never exact
                key = address if address not in self.rows else (address, name)
                self.rows[key] = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': None,
                                  'exact': False, 'counted_class': bool(OWN.search(name)), 'bounds': str(error)}
                return
        exact = match.exact_match(target, target_refs, body, refs)
        entry = {'address': '%08x' % address, 'symbol': name, 'size': len(body), 'target_size': len(target),
                 'exact': exact, 'counted_class': bool(OWN.search(name))}
        if split:
            entry['extent_split'] = 'piece %s+%#x of the evidence extent %s (bounds; not counted)' % (
                '%08x' % split[0], split[1] - split[0], '%08x' % split[0])
        key = address if address not in self.rows else (address, name)
        self.rows[key] = entry
        if not exact:
            return
        start, section = self.definitions[name]
        table = self.sections[section]
        code = self.raw[table[4] + start:]
        verified, local = {}, set()
        for i in range(table[7]):
            offset, index, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IIH', self.raw, table[5] + 10 * i)
            offset -= start
            if not 0 <= offset < len(body):
                continue
            symbol = self.symbols[index][0]
            if kind == 20:
                value = (address + offset + 4 + struct.unpack_from('<i', target, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            else:
                value = (struct.unpack_from('<I', target, offset)[0] - struct.unpack_from('<i', code, offset)[0]) & 0xffffffff
            if LOCAL_EH.match(symbol):
                local.add(symbol)
                continue
            how = self.classify(symbol, value, name)
            if how is None:
                UNBOUND.append('%s: %s in %s -> %s' % (self.name, symbol, name, hex(value)))
                continue
            self.bind(symbol, value, name)
            verified[symbol] = '%s (%s)' % (hex(value), how)
        entry.update({'verified_targets': verified, 'local_eh': sorted(local)})

    def run(self, seeds):
        for address, name in seeds:
            assert name in self.bodies, (self.name, name)
            self.bind(name, address, 'seed')
